tuples.evidence_lens: open the hands fully and let them close; the hands have been working and will report immediately

tuples.episode_object: the ceiling looked at for five seconds
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk where there is no window to look through
tuples.mechanism: a change of gaze direction with no view required
tuples.evidence_lens: up is always available; a view is a luxury and this practice does not need one

tuples.episode_object: the room's sounds returning to notice
tuples.time_place_scope: a workspace after deep concentration
tuples.mechanism: ambient sound allowed back in
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to what was there all along; concentration hides a room and stopping reveals it

tuples.episode_object: a to-do list read once without acting
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment before choosing the next task
tuples.mechanism: reading without immediately doing
tuples.evidence_lens: read the list, then look away before deciding; the gap between reading and acting is where the reset lives

tuples.episode_object: the small of the back against the chair
tuples.time_place_scope: a chair that has been sat in for two hours
tuples.mechanism: noticing where the body meets the furniture
tuples.evidence_lens: find the contact points one at a time; the chair has been holding you the whole time unnoticed

tuples.episode_object: a colleague passing behind the desk
tuples.time_place_scope: an open-plan office in the middle of the day
tuples.mechanism: noticing a movement without following it
tuples.evidence_lens: see them and return; the return is the repetition and it can happen twenty times an hour

tuples.episode_object: a long exhale at the top of a breath
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk in the pause between two demands
tuples.mechanism: a single lengthened out-breath
tuples.evidence_lens: one breath out, longer than the one in; nothing needs counting beyond that comparison

tuples.episode_object: a pen put back in a pot
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk being cleared before the next task
tuples.mechanism: one object returned to its place
tuples.evidence_lens: return one thing only; a single act of order beats a postponed tidy-up every time

tuples.episode_object: the last line of a finished email
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment before pressing send
tuples.mechanism: a final reading done slowly
tuples.evidence_lens: read it once at reading speed rather than scanning; a slow read is both better work and a real pause

tuples.episode_object: a window seen across the office
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk positioned away from the daylight
tuples.mechanism: looking toward light without moving to it
tuples.evidence_lens: turn the head rather than getting up; small movements are the ones that survive a busy day

tuples.episode_object: the quiet before the next thing begins
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk with the previous task genuinely finished
tuples.mechanism: a gap protected from being filled
tuples.evidence_lens: hold the gap for ten seconds; ten seconds unfilled is more than most working days contain

tuples.episode_object: the first deliberate keystroke of the next task
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of beginning again
tuples.mechanism: a start made consciously rather than by drift
tuples.evidence_lens: choose the first action and take it; a chosen beginning makes the whole task feel less accidental

tuples.episode_object: the edge of the desk gripped with both hands
tuples.time_place_scope: a workstation in mid-afternoon
tuples.mechanism: supported shoulder release
tuples.evidence_lens: use the desk to take some weight; supported stretches are safer and more repeatable than unsupported ones

tuples.episode_object: a chair back used as a brace
tuples.time_place_scope: an office chair with a firm back
tuples.mechanism: choice-based range of motion
tuples.evidence_lens: go only as far as is comfortable and stop there; the stopping point is yours and may change daily

tuples.episode_object: shoulders rolled backwards three times
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk after a morning of hunching forward
tuples.mechanism: a short repeated movement counted
tuples.evidence_lens: three is enough and three is the whole instruction; small fixed numbers get done

tuples.episode_object: one side of the neck lengthened gently
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk where the head has been turned one way all morning
tuples.mechanism: asymmetry corrected slowly
tuples.evidence_lens: never pull; let weight do the work and stop at the first firm resistance

tuples.episode_object: wrists circled in both directions
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk after continuous typing
tuples.mechanism: a joint moved through its easy range
tuples.evidence_lens: both directions, equally; symmetry is a simple rule that removes the need to judge

tuples.episode_object: hands laced and lifted overhead
tuples.time_place_scope: a workspace with enough room to raise the arms
tuples.mechanism: lengthening the sides of the body
tuples.evidence_lens: breathe in as the arms rise and out as they lower; matching movement to breath needs no extra attention

tuples.episode_object: the spine lengthened while seated
tuples.time_place_scope: a chair that has encouraged slumping for hours
tuples.mechanism: posture adjusted without stiffening
tuples.evidence_lens: lift without bracing; a rigid correction is worse than the slump it replaced

tuples.episode_object: both feet planted and pressed down
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk with a footrest or a firm floor
tuples.mechanism: pressing down to feel the whole leg
tuples.evidence_lens: push through the heels and feel the chain up to the hips; pressure reveals what stillness hides

tuples.episode_object: a gentle forward fold over the thighs
tuples.time_place_scope: a private office or a quiet corner
tuples.mechanism: a supported fold with the head low
tuples.evidence_lens: come up slowly and pause halfway; the return is the part that needs the care

tuples.episode_object: a slow twist using the chair arm
tuples.time_place_scope: a swivel chair with a fixed armrest
tuples.mechanism: rotation taken to a comfortable limit
tuples.evidence_lens: turn the eyes last, not first; leading with the head is where twists usually go wrong

tuples.episode_object: calves squeezed and released under the desk
tuples.time_place_scope: a long seated stretch with no chance to stand
tuples.mechanism: an invisible movement done at the desk
tuples.evidence_lens: nobody needs to see this; a hidden movement counts exactly as much as a visible one

tuples.episode_object: a jaw deliberately unclenched
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk during a demanding piece of work
tuples.mechanism: releasing a habitually held muscle
tuples.evidence_lens: let the teeth part slightly; the jaw usually reports the day more accurately than the mind does

tuples.episode_object: fingers spread and held wide
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk after an hour on a keyboard
tuples.mechanism: an opposite movement to the day's habit
tuples.evidence_lens: do the reverse of what you have been doing; opposites are easy to choose and easy to feel

tuples.episode_object: the chest opened in a doorway
tuples.time_place_scope: a corridor beside the office
tuples.mechanism: a stretch taken with an available structure
tuples.evidence_lens: use what the building offers; equipment is never required for any of this

tuples.episode_object: hip flexors felt on standing up
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of rising after two hours seated
tuples.mechanism: noticing tightness as it appears
tuples.evidence_lens: stand and wait five seconds before walking; the body reports most clearly in the first few seconds

tuples.episode_object: the ribcage widening on an in-breath
tuples.time_place_scope: a seated pause with the hands on the lower ribs
tuples.mechanism: breath located by touch
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the movement with the hands rather than trying to breathe correctly; there is no correct here

tuples.episode_object: ankles rotated under the desk
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk where the feet have been still all morning
tuples.mechanism: a small joint moved deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: the smallest joints are the most neglected; attention there is unusually vivid

tuples.episode_object: the lower back supported by a cushion
tuples.time_place_scope: a chair adjusted partway through the day
tuples.mechanism: one change made to the setup
tuples.evidence_lens: change one thing and notice the result; adjusting the environment is a legitimate form of care

tuples.episode_object: shoulders let down on an exhale
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk after a tense phone call
tuples.mechanism: release timed to the out-breath
tuples.evidence_lens: let the breath out first and the shoulders will follow; forcing the order the other way rarely works

tuples.episode_object: sitting back down with intention
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a short stretch break
tuples.mechanism: a return to work made deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: sit as though choosing to; how you sit back down sets the tone for the next hour

tuples.episode_object: a laptop lid closed completely
tuples.time_place_scope: the first minute after a long screen session
tuples.mechanism: a full stop rather than a pause
tuples.evidence_lens: closing is different from minimising; the difference is felt, not argued

tuples.episode_object: the eyes refocusing on the far wall
tuples.time_place_scope: a room with a clear line of sight across it
tuples.mechanism: near-to-far gaze shifting
tuples.evidence_lens: look near, then far, then near again; the muscles doing this have been locked for an hour

tuples.episode_object: a window across the room
tuples.time_place_scope: an office where the desk faces away from daylight
tuples.mechanism: distance found through glass
tuples.evidence_lens: find the furthest visible thing and rest there; the further, the better, and there is no wrong answer

tuples.episode_object: dry eyes blinking deliberately
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of an afternoon of continuous reading
tuples.mechanism: a reflex performed on purpose
tuples.evidence_lens: ten slow blinks; screens suppress blinking and the correction is immediate and physical

tuples.episode_object: a hand lifted off the mouse
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk where one hand has held the same shape for hours
tuples.mechanism: a fixed grip released
tuples.evidence_lens: open the hand and let it hang; the shape it holds afterwards tells you how long it was there

tuples.episode_object: the room's own sounds becoming audible
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment headphones come off
tuples.mechanism: ambient sound returning after isolation
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to the room for one breath before speaking to anyone; re-entry is smoother when it is noticed

tuples.episode_object: the neck after hours of looking down
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk with a low laptop screen
tuples.mechanism: noticing a posture's cost without correcting it yet
tuples.evidence_lens: observe first, adjust second; observing changes what the adjustment ends up being

tuples.episode_object: a plant on a shelf
tuples.time_place_scope: a workspace with one living thing in it
tuples.mechanism: looking at something that is not a rectangle
tuples.evidence_lens: choose an irregular shape on purpose; screens are all edges and the eyes are tired of them

tuples.episode_object: a closed laptop carried to another room
tuples.time_place_scope: a short walk after finishing screen work
tuples.mechanism: whole-body transition away from the device
tuples.evidence_lens: move the body and the machine together; the walk is the practice and the destination does not matter

tuples.episode_object: cold water on the face at a sink
tuples.time_place_scope: a bathroom break after a long stretch of work
tuples.mechanism: a strong sensation used to mark a change
tuples.evidence_lens: cold water works quickly; the sharpness is the feature, not a shock to be avoided

tuples.episode_object: a phone also set aside
tuples.time_place_scope: the minute after leaving one screen for another
tuples.mechanism: noticing a substitution before it happens
tuples.evidence_lens: catch the swap from one screen to the next; catching it is enough, and stopping it is optional

tuples.episode_object: sunlight lying across part of the floor
tuples.time_place_scope: an afternoon room with the blinds partly open
tuples.mechanism: natural light noticed after artificial light
tuples.evidence_lens: stand in it for thirty seconds; the contrast with a backlit screen does most of the work

tuples.episode_object: shoulders that have crept forward
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a long stretch at a keyboard
tuples.mechanism: noticing a drift that happened unobserved
tuples.evidence_lens: find where the shoulders ended up; the surprise of the answer is the useful part

tuples.episode_object: the ceiling seen with the head tipped back
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk with no view and no space to walk
tuples.mechanism: an upward gaze taken in a confined space
tuples.evidence_lens: tip the head back for five seconds only; small confined spaces still allow a change of direction

tuples.episode_object: eyes closed with the palms warmed first
tuples.time_place_scope: a quiet moment at a desk between calls
tuples.mechanism: darkness and warmth combined briefly
tuples.evidence_lens: rub the palms, cup the eyes, and stay for three breaths; two sensations at once are easier to stay with than one

tuples.episode_object: the fingers after continuous typing
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk at the end of a writing session
tuples.mechanism: attention paid to the parts that did the work
tuples.evidence_lens: thank is the wrong word, but notice is the right one; the hands did something and can be acknowledged

tuples.episode_object: the desk surface wiped once
tuples.time_place_scope: a workspace at the end of a screen-heavy day
tuples.mechanism: a physical task chosen after a mental one
tuples.evidence_lens: do something with the hands that has an obvious result; contrast with screen work is the point

tuples.episode_object: a screen's hum no longer audible
tuples.time_place_scope: the seconds after a monitor is switched off
tuples.mechanism: noticing a background sound end
tuples.evidence_lens: listen for the absence; a sound you never noticed becomes obvious the moment it stops

tuples.episode_object: a distant tree seen through the window
tuples.time_place_scope: a workspace with a long view outside
tuples.mechanism: a moving natural object watched briefly
tuples.evidence_lens: movement that nobody designed is restful in a way designed movement is not

tuples.episode_object: one deliberate step away from the desk
tuples.time_place_scope: the final action of the pause
tuples.mechanism: a physical departure that ends the practice
tuples.evidence_lens: take one step and mean it; the step is what stops this becoming another minute at the desk

coverage_profiles.subject: the last email of the day

tuples.episode_object: a send button under the cursor
tuples.time_place_scope: the final message before finishing work
tuples.mechanism: a pause taken before an irreversible action
tuples.evidence_lens: one breath with the cursor already in place; the pause costs a second and is felt as a decision

tuples.episode_object: an inbox count that will not reach zero
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a day with more arriving than leaving
tuples.mechanism: accepting an unfinished state deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: say plainly that it is unfinished, then stop anyway; naming it is what makes stopping possible

tuples.episode_object: a sign-off line typed carefully
tuples.time_place_scope: a message written at the end of a tiring day
tuples.mechanism: attention given to the last few words
tuples.evidence_lens: write the last line as though it were the first; tired writing is where attention is most needed

tuples.episode_object: a draft saved rather than sent
tuples.time_place_scope: an evening where the message could wait until morning
tuples.mechanism: a deliberate decision not to act
tuples.evidence_lens: choose the delay rather than drift into it; a chosen deferral does not follow you home

tuples.episode_object: the mouse released and hands withdrawn
tuples.time_place_scope: the second after the message goes
tuples.mechanism: hands taken off the controls
tuples.evidence_lens: let go physically before letting go mentally; the body usually leads and the mind follows

tuples.episode_object: one line written in a notebook for tomorrow
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk in the last minutes of the working day
tuples.mechanism: a single note that closes an open loop
tuples.evidence_lens: one line only, and no more; a short note ends the thinking, a long one continues it

tuples.episode_object: a thread left open on purpose
tuples.time_place_scope: an unresolved conversation at the end of the week
tuples.mechanism: noticing the pull to resolve everything
tuples.evidence_lens: see the wish to finish it tonight; wishing and acting are two different things and only one is required

tuples.episode_object: a desk lamp switched off
tuples.time_place_scope: a workspace at dusk with the overhead lights already out
tuples.mechanism: a change of light marking a change of state
tuples.evidence_lens: let the room dim and stay for one breath in the new light; light changes register faster than announcements

tuples.episode_object: the office growing quieter around the desk
tuples.time_place_scope: a workplace as colleagues leave one by one
tuples.mechanism: noticing a gradual change in a room
tuples.evidence_lens: observe how much quieter it is than an hour ago; gradual changes only exist if someone compares

tuples.episode_object: a clock read once, not repeatedly
tuples.time_place_scope: the last stretch of the working day
tuples.mechanism: checking once and accepting the answer
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the time a single time; repeated checking is the habit being worked with here

tuples.episode_object: a laptop closed and set square on the desk
tuples.time_place_scope: a home office where work and evening share a room
tuples.mechanism: a boundary made physical in a shared space
tuples.evidence_lens: square it up deliberately; when there is no commute, the object has to do the separating

tuples.episode_object: a final read-through at reading speed
tuples.time_place_scope: a message that matters more than most
tuples.mechanism: slowing down for the last check
tuples.evidence_lens: read every word rather than the shape of the sentence; care here is both good practice and good work

tuples.episode_object: a bag packed in a fixed order
tuples.time_place_scope: the last five minutes in the office
tuples.mechanism: a familiar sequence performed with attention
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the order you always use; long-standing sequences are invisible until they are watched

tuples.episode_object: a colleague's goodnight across the room
tuples.time_place_scope: an office emptying at the end of the day
tuples.mechanism: one exchange completed properly
tuples.evidence_lens: look up and answer with your whole attention; three seconds given fully is a complete practice

tuples.episode_object: the screen dimming to black
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment the monitor is switched off
tuples.mechanism: watching a light source go out
tuples.evidence_lens: watch it go rather than looking away first; endings watched to completion feel finished

tuples.episode_object: a chair pushed back under the desk
tuples.time_place_scope: a workstation being left for the night
tuples.mechanism: a small tidying act that signals departure
tuples.evidence_lens: push the chair in as the last physical act; the desk is left ready and so, roughly, are you

tuples.episode_object: a keyboard shortcut used without thinking
tuples.time_place_scope: a routine action at the end of a routine day
tuples.mechanism: noticing skilled automation in yourself
tuples.evidence_lens: catch the hands knowing something the mind was not tracking; that gap is interesting and worth a look

tuples.episode_object: the corridor outside the office
tuples.time_place_scope: the first steps away from the desk
tuples.mechanism: a change of room used to mark a change of role
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the different air and the different sound; buildings help with transitions if they are allowed to

tuples.episode_object: a key turned in an office door
tuples.time_place_scope: the last person leaving a workplace
tuples.mechanism: a definite closing action
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the lock engage; mechanical certainty is a plain and useful thing at the end of a day

tuples.episode_object: the first breath outside the building
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of stepping out into the evening
tuples.mechanism: outdoor air met at the end of the day
tuples.evidence_lens: one breath before deciding anything about the evening; the decision will be better and so will the breath

tuples.episode_object: a bench slat warm from the sun
tuples.time_place_scope: a park bench at midday in late spring
tuples.mechanism: warmth taken from a surface
tuples.evidence_lens: sit and let the bench be warmer than you; borrowed warmth is noticed in seconds

tuples.episode_object: the first bite of a sandwich
tuples.time_place_scope: an outdoor break with only twenty minutes
tuples.mechanism: one mouthful eaten without doing anything else
tuples.evidence_lens: the first bite only, then carry on normally; one bite is a realistic target on a short break

tuples.episode_object: a paper bag rustling in the hands
tuples.time_place_scope: a windy day on a bench near a road
tuples.mechanism: a small sound followed in a noisy place
tuples.evidence_lens: find the nearest sound and keep it; near sounds win against far ones if they are chosen

tuples.episode_object: grass under both hands
tuples.time_place_scope: a lawn on a dry summer afternoon
tuples.mechanism: texture taken from the ground itself
tuples.evidence_lens: put the hands down and describe what they find; the ground answers immediately

tuples.episode_object: shade moving across a lap
tuples.time_place_scope: a seat beneath a tree with the sun moving
tuples.mechanism: a slow change of light watched
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the edge of the shade, then look again in five minutes; two observations make a change visible

tuples.episode_object: a coffee cup held with both hands outdoors
tuples.time_place_scope: a cold break taken outside anyway
tuples.mechanism: a warm object in a cold place
tuples.evidence_lens: the contrast does the work; discomfort and comfort together are more vivid than either alone

tuples.episode_object: birds moving between the paving stones
tuples.time_place_scope: a city square at lunchtime
tuples.mechanism: small movements tracked briefly
tuples.evidence_lens: follow one bird until it flies; a short natural ending is better than a decided one

tuples.episode_object: traffic noise heard from a distance
tuples.time_place_scope: a green space just off a busy street
tuples.mechanism: a background sound held at its distance
tuples.evidence_lens: hear how far away it is; distance is a property of sound and can be attended to directly

tuples.episode_object: a low wall used as a seat
tuples.time_place_scope: a break taken somewhere with no proper bench
tuples.mechanism: making do with the available seat
tuples.evidence_lens: an imperfect seat is a complete seat; the practice never required comfort

tuples.episode_object: a phone left in a coat pocket
tuples.time_place_scope: a break where the phone usually comes straight out
tuples.mechanism: a habitual reach declined for a set time
tuples.evidence_lens: five minutes, then do as you like; a bounded abstention is honest and achievable

tuples.episode_object: the sound of water in a fountain
tuples.time_place_scope: a public square with running water
tuples.mechanism: continuous water sound rested on
tuples.evidence_lens: running water needs no interpretation; that is exactly why it works

tuples.episode_object: people passing without being watched closely
tuples.time_place_scope: a busy pedestrian street at lunchtime
tuples.mechanism: soft peripheral awareness of movement
tuples.evidence_lens: let people be movement rather than stories; the shift is subtle and noticeable

tuples.episode_object: cold air on the back of the hands
tuples.time_place_scope: a break taken outdoors in early winter
tuples.mechanism: cold met at an exposed place
tuples.evidence_lens: one specific patch of skin, one specific sensation; go back inside whenever you choose

tuples.episode_object: steps used as a place to sit
tuples.time_place_scope: a building's front steps between meetings
tuples.mechanism: a short sit in an unlikely place
tuples.evidence_lens: sitting somewhere odd is permitted; the oddness itself keeps the mind present

tuples.episode_object: the ground felt through the soles while standing
tuples.time_place_scope: a break where sitting is not possible
tuples.mechanism: grounding taken standing up
tuples.evidence_lens: standing works as well as sitting; nothing about this requires a seat

tuples.episode_object: the smell of cut grass
tuples.time_place_scope: a park in the hour after mowing
tuples.mechanism: a strong seasonal smell noticed and named
tuples.evidence_lens: name it before deciding whether it pleases you; naming comes first, judgement is optional

tuples.episode_object: a jacket taken off and folded
tuples.time_place_scope: the first genuinely warm lunchtime of the year
tuples.mechanism: a change of temperature acted upon
tuples.evidence_lens: adjust deliberately rather than absently; comfort chosen on purpose is a small piece of self-attention

tuples.episode_object: a clock or a phone checked once
tuples.time_place_scope: the middle of a break with a fixed end
tuples.mechanism: a single check rather than repeated checking
tuples.evidence_lens: look once and put it away; the second look is the one worth declining

tuples.episode_object: crumbs brushed from the lap
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of an outdoor meal
tuples.mechanism: a small tidying act closing an activity
tuples.evidence_lens: brush once, deliberately; the gesture is the ending and it takes two seconds

tuples.episode_object: standing up to go back inside
tuples.time_place_scope: the final moment of the break
tuples.mechanism: an ending taken at your own pace
tuples.evidence_lens: stand before you have to, not after; ending on your own terms is the difference between a break and an interruption

tuples.episode_object: a door unlocked before anyone else arrives
tuples.time_place_scope: the first arrival of the morning
tuples.mechanism: a first action in an empty building
tuples.evidence_lens: notice that yours is the first sound in the room; being first is a condition worth using

tuples.episode_object: lights switched on one bank at a time
tuples.time_place_scope: an office before the working day begins
tuples.mechanism: a gradual change made in stages
tuples.evidence_lens: turn on only what you need; the choice not to fill the room is itself the practice

tuples.episode_object: the building's ventilation hum
tuples.time_place_scope: a quiet workplace before the noise starts
tuples.mechanism: a constant background sound noticed while it is audible
tuples.evidence_lens: hear it now, because in an hour it will be inaudible; early quiet reveals what daytime hides

tuples.episode_object: a cold desk surface under the palms
tuples.time_place_scope: an unheated office at the start of the day
tuples.mechanism: temperature met at the workspace itself
tuples.evidence_lens: put both hands on the desk before opening anything; the desk is the first thing you touch anyway

tuples.episode_object: a chair pulled out and adjusted
tuples.time_place_scope: a workstation being set up for the day
tuples.mechanism: one deliberate adjustment before starting
tuples.evidence_lens: adjust the chair on purpose once; the day is long and the setup is the cheapest thing to get right

tuples.episode_object: a coat hung on a hook
tuples.time_place_scope: an entrance area at the start of a shift
tuples.mechanism: a single object placed to mark arrival
tuples.evidence_lens: hang it rather than draping it; the extra second is the whole difference

tuples.episode_object: a computer's start-up sound
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk in the first minutes of the day
tuples.mechanism: a machine's beginning used as a bell
tuples.evidence_lens: one breath while it starts; the wait exists whether or not it is used

tuples.episode_object: blinds opened onto early light
tuples.time_place_scope: an office facing east on a clear morning
tuples.mechanism: daylight let in deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: open them before switching anything on; the order of the first three actions can be chosen

tuples.episode_object: tools laid out on a bench
tuples.time_place_scope: a workshop before the first job of the day
tuples.mechanism: an ordered arrangement checked by eye
tuples.evidence_lens: look along the row once; a prepared space is a form of attention already stored

tuples.episode_object: a shop floor before the doors open
tuples.time_place_scope: a retail space in the last quiet half-hour
tuples.mechanism: stillness noticed in a space designed for movement
tuples.evidence_lens: stand still in a place that will soon be busy; the contrast will be obvious in an hour

tuples.episode_object: empty chairs in a classroom
tuples.time_place_scope: a teaching room before the pupils arrive
tuples.mechanism: looking at a space that is about to change
tuples.evidence_lens: see the room as it is now, not as it will be; the present state is the only one available

tuples.episode_object: the smell of a room that has been shut overnight
tuples.time_place_scope: an office opened first thing in the morning
tuples.mechanism: a smell noticed before habituation removes it
tuples.evidence_lens: smell it in the first ten seconds; after that the nose stops reporting

tuples.episode_object: a desk left tidy the night before
tuples.time_place_scope: a workstation returned to after a good ending
tuples.mechanism: noticing the result of a past decision
tuples.evidence_lens: register what yesterday's version of you did; the practice extends backwards as well as forwards

tuples.episode_object: a kettle filled in a shared kitchen
tuples.time_place_scope: a workplace kitchen with nobody else in it
tuples.mechanism: a routine act performed in unusual quiet
tuples.evidence_lens: the same act is different without an audience; notice which parts you do differently

tuples.episode_object: a corridor walked without meeting anyone
tuples.time_place_scope: a large building early in the morning
tuples.mechanism: walking at your own pace in a shared space
tuples.evidence_lens: set the pace yourself for once; corridors normally set it for you

tuples.episode_object: a window opened before the heating comes on
tuples.time_place_scope: a stuffy office at the start of the day
tuples.mechanism: air changed deliberately at the start
tuples.evidence_lens: open it, stand for one breath, then begin; the sequence takes fifteen seconds

tuples.episode_object: the first task still unopened
tuples.time_place_scope: the minute after sitting down but before starting
tuples.mechanism: a gap held before work begins
tuples.evidence_lens: sit for thirty seconds with nothing open; this gap disappears the instant anything is opened

tuples.episode_object: a note left for a colleague
tuples.time_place_scope: a shared workspace before the shift changes
tuples.mechanism: a small act of care for someone not yet present
tuples.evidence_lens: write it properly rather than hastily; the care is for them and the attention is for you

tuples.episode_object: the sound of the first colleague arriving
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of the quiet period
tuples.mechanism: noticing a transition as it happens
tuples.evidence_lens: hear the door and mark the change; the quiet had a beginning and now it has an end

tuples.episode_object: a list of the day written before it starts
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk in the last minutes of solitude
tuples.mechanism: planning done once and then set down
tuples.evidence_lens: write it, then close the notebook; the closing is what stops the planning continuing all morning

tuples.episode_object: a wooden chopping board under a knife
tuples.time_place_scope: an evening kitchen with the meal not yet started
tuples.mechanism: sound-and-texture attention while cutting
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to the knife meeting the board; the sound changes with what is being cut and reports on it

tuples.episode_object: an onion's layers separating
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen at the beginning of a familiar recipe
tuples.mechanism: close looking at a structure
tuples.evidence_lens: look at what you are cutting rather than through it; familiar ingredients are rarely actually seen

tuples.episode_object: cold water running over vegetables
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink with the day's shopping just unpacked
tuples.mechanism: cold noticed at the hands during a routine task
tuples.evidence_lens: the water is already cold and the hands are already in it; only the noticing has to be added

tuples.episode_object: a pan heating before anything goes in
tuples.time_place_scope: a hob in the minute before cooking properly starts
tuples.mechanism: waiting for a temperature to be reached
tuples.evidence_lens: hold a hand above the pan and wait; the waiting is required by the cooking anyway

tuples.episode_object: oil moving as the pan tilts
tuples.time_place_scope: a stove in the first seconds of cooking
tuples.mechanism: watching a liquid change with heat
tuples.evidence_lens: see it thin and run; a physical change with a clear before and after is easy to stay with

tuples.episode_object: herbs crushed between finger and thumb
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen with fresh herbs on the counter
tuples.mechanism: scent released by a deliberate action
tuples.evidence_lens: crush, then smell, in that order; making the smell happen is different from encountering it

tuples.episode_object: a wooden spoon moving through a pan
tuples.time_place_scope: a slow dish that needs occasional stirring
tuples.mechanism: repetitive hand movement with a light grip
tuples.evidence_lens: stir at a speed you chose; slow cooking gives you the time and does not ask for it back

tuples.episode_object: a kitchen bowl held against the hip
tuples.time_place_scope: a shared home with more than one cook
tuples.mechanism: a load carried against the body
tuples.evidence_lens: notice where the weight is taken; the body finds solutions that were never decided

tuples.episode_object: a timer set for a known length
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen with something in the oven
tuples.mechanism: an external boundary accepted
tuples.evidence_lens: let the timer own the time; nothing needs checking until it sounds

tuples.episode_object: steam rising into the face over a pot
tuples.time_place_scope: a stove with something at a simmer
tuples.mechanism: warm damp air met at the face
tuples.evidence_lens: lean in, one breath, then step back; the sensation is strong and brief and needs no extension

tuples.episode_object: a pinch of salt taken between the fingers
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen at the seasoning stage of a dish
tuples.mechanism: a small precise measurement made by feel
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the amount rather than estimating it; hands learn quantities if they are allowed to

tuples.episode_object: a fridge door held open in a warm kitchen
tuples.time_place_scope: a hot evening in a kitchen with the oven on
tuples.mechanism: a temperature edge crossed briefly
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the cold air fall out; a boundary between two temperatures is unusually easy to feel

tuples.episode_object: a lid lifted and set down
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen where something is checked mid-cook
tuples.mechanism: one action with an immediate change in sound
tuples.evidence_lens: lift and hear the difference; the pot gets louder and quieter and it is free information

tuples.episode_object: a spoonful tasted and considered
tuples.time_place_scope: a dish nearly ready to serve
tuples.mechanism: tasting attentively rather than habitually
tuples.evidence_lens: taste, wait, then decide; the pause between tasting and deciding is where the attention sits

tuples.episode_object: vegetables arranged before cooking begins
tuples.time_place_scope: a counter during preparation with nothing yet on the heat
tuples.mechanism: laying out a sequence in advance
tuples.evidence_lens: prepare everything before starting; the order of a kitchen is a form of calm that lasts all evening

tuples.episode_object: a knife washed and set aside immediately
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen where clearing happens as you go
tuples.mechanism: one thing finished before the next begins
tuples.evidence_lens: deal with it now rather than later; the practice and the housekeeping are the same act

tuples.episode_object: the sound of something reaching a boil
tuples.time_place_scope: a hob with a pan that has been quiet
tuples.mechanism: a change of sound noticed without watching
tuples.evidence_lens: cook by ear for one minute; using the wrong sense on purpose sharpens both

tuples.episode_object: a plate warmed before serving
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen in the last minute before the meal
tuples.mechanism: a small extra step taken deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: do the optional thing once; unnecessary care is where attention shows most clearly

tuples.episode_object: food arranged on a plate
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of serving a meal at home
tuples.mechanism: placing with care rather than speed
tuples.evidence_lens: place, do not tip; the ten seconds spent here are the last of the cooking

tuples.episode_object: the table laid before sitting down
tuples.time_place_scope: a dining table in the minute before eating
tuples.mechanism: a preparation completed before the event
tuples.evidence_lens: finish laying the table before the first mouthful; a clear boundary between making and eating

tuples.episode_object: warm water rising around the wrists
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen sink after the evening meal
tuples.mechanism: warmth met at the forearms
tuples.evidence_lens: stay for the first ten seconds of warmth; the sensation is strongest before the skin adapts

tuples.episode_object: suds thinning as the water works
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink partway through a large stack
tuples.mechanism: watching a slow change in a familiar substance
tuples.evidence_lens: notice when the foam goes; the change happens whether or not anyone sees it

tuples.episode_object: the flat face of a plate under a sponge
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink with plates first in the order
tuples.mechanism: a repeated circular movement
tuples.evidence_lens: one plate, one continuous circle; a single unbroken movement is a complete unit of attention

tuples.episode_object: a glass held up to the window light
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink beneath a window in daylight
tuples.mechanism: checking by looking rather than by assuming
tuples.evidence_lens: hold it up and actually look; checking properly is both better washing and a real pause

tuples.episode_object: a burnt pan needing more effort
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink at the end of a meal that stuck
tuples.mechanism: sustained effort noticed in the arm
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the work in the forearm; hard tasks give clearer physical reports than easy ones

tuples.episode_object: cutlery clinking in the bottom of the bowl
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink with the small items left until last
tuples.mechanism: a scattered sound accepted as it is
tuples.evidence_lens: let the clatter be the sound of the minute; it does not need to be quiet to be attended to

tuples.episode_object: fingertips wrinkling after long immersion
tuples.time_place_scope: a long wash after a meal with guests
tuples.mechanism: a bodily change noticed after the fact
tuples.evidence_lens: look at your own hands; the body has been keeping time all along

tuples.episode_object: the sink's cool edge against the stomach
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen where you lean in to reach the tap
tuples.mechanism: a contact point found at the torso
tuples.evidence_lens: notice where the body braces; leaning is a posture and postures can be examined

tuples.episode_object: a stack on the drainer growing
tuples.time_place_scope: a wash that has been going on for several minutes
tuples.mechanism: progress observed without hurrying it
tuples.evidence_lens: see the stack rather than the remaining pile; which half you look at changes the minute

tuples.episode_object: a mug's handle turned in the hand
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink working through the morning's cups
tuples.mechanism: an object rotated to reach every part
tuples.evidence_lens: turn it all the way round; thoroughness and attention are the same movement here

tuples.episode_object: the tap's temperature adjusted by degrees
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink where the water has run too hot
tuples.mechanism: a small correction made carefully
tuples.evidence_lens: adjust in small amounts and wait between; waiting for the change is where the attention goes

tuples.episode_object: a window over the sink in the evening
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen at dusk with the light going
tuples.mechanism: an outward look during an inward task
tuples.evidence_lens: look up between items; the hands can continue while the eyes go somewhere else

tuples.episode_object: the sound of running water changing pitch
tuples.time_place_scope: a rinse under a tap with the bowl filling
tuples.mechanism: pitch followed as a level changes
tuples.evidence_lens: listen rather than watch the level; the ears are perfectly capable and rarely asked

tuples.episode_object: a cloth wrung out over the sink
tuples.time_place_scope: the last stage of clearing a kitchen
tuples.mechanism: a two-handed twisting action done slowly
tuples.evidence_lens: wring it out deliberately; a strong simple movement is easy to feel and easy to repeat

tuples.episode_object: the plug pulled and the water dropping
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a wash with the sink still full
tuples.mechanism: watching something empty at its own rate
tuples.evidence_lens: watch it drain rather than walking away; the practice ends when the sink does

tuples.episode_object: the drain's changing sound as it empties
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink in the final seconds of draining
tuples.mechanism: a sound followed to its last moment
tuples.evidence_lens: wait for the final gulp; endings that announce themselves are the easiest ones to notice

tuples.episode_object: a tea towel taken from a rail
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen moving from washing to drying
tuples.mechanism: a change of task marked by a change of object
tuples.evidence_lens: pick up the towel deliberately; the object change is the marker between two halves

tuples.episode_object: a plate dried and put away in one movement
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen being fully cleared before bed
tuples.mechanism: finishing each item completely
tuples.evidence_lens: one item, all the way to the cupboard; completion per item beats completion per stage tonight

tuples.episode_object: the counter wiped in a single pass
tuples.time_place_scope: the last act of clearing the kitchen
tuples.mechanism: one closing movement across a surface
tuples.evidence_lens: one pass and stop; deciding in advance that one is enough is the discipline

tuples.episode_object: an empty, quiet sink
tuples.time_place_scope: the kitchen once everything is done
tuples.mechanism: looking at a finished state
tuples.evidence_lens: stand and look at it for five seconds; finished things are rarely looked at once they are finished

tuples.episode_object: a towel folded in three and then in half
tuples.time_place_scope: a laundry table on an ordinary afternoon
tuples.mechanism: a fixed sequence repeated identically
tuples.evidence_lens: same folds, same order, every time; repetition without variation is what makes this restful

tuples.episode_object: warmth still held in clothes from the dryer
tuples.time_place_scope: a basket brought straight from a finished cycle
tuples.mechanism: warmth found in an unexpected object
tuples.evidence_lens: put the hands into the pile before folding anything; the warmth is brief and free

tuples.episode_object: a shirt sleeve straightened along its seam
tuples.time_place_scope: a table with a stack of shirts to work through
tuples.mechanism: following a line with the fingers
tuples.evidence_lens: run a finger down the seam; a straight line is a simple thing to follow and hard to lose

tuples.episode_object: two socks matched from a mixed pile
tuples.time_place_scope: a floor or bed covered in unsorted washing
tuples.mechanism: a small searching task with clear success
tuples.evidence_lens: one match at a time; a task with obvious completions gives the mind somewhere to land repeatedly

tuples.episode_object: a sheet folded with another person
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where two people are working together
tuples.mechanism: coordinated movement with someone else
tuples.evidence_lens: watch their hands and match them; shared timing is attention that neither person has to hold alone

tuples.episode_object: the smell of clean fabric
tuples.time_place_scope: a basket opened for the first time after drying
tuples.mechanism: a smell noticed at its strongest moment
tuples.evidence_lens: smell it in the first few seconds; wait five minutes and it will have gone

tuples.episode_object: a fitted sheet resisting a neat fold
tuples.time_place_scope: a laundry pile with bedding at the bottom
tuples.mechanism: frustration observed during a small failure
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the irritation and fold it roughly anyway; the outcome is not what is being practised

tuples.episode_object: buttons fastened before folding
tuples.time_place_scope: a table with shirts that will go in a wardrobe
tuples.mechanism: a small extra step taken for later ease
tuples.evidence_lens: do the extra step once; care taken now for later is a quiet form of attention

tuples.episode_object: a stack growing square and even
tuples.time_place_scope: a folding session that is going well
tuples.mechanism: alignment checked by eye
tuples.evidence_lens: look along the edges; a straight stack is visible proof that attention was present

tuples.episode_object: a child's small clothing among adult sizes
tuples.time_place_scope: a household laundry with several people's things
tuples.mechanism: noticing a change of scale in the hands
tuples.evidence_lens: register the difference in size without adding a story; the observation is complete as it stands

tuples.episode_object: fabric snapped straight before folding
tuples.time_place_scope: a room with space to shake something out
tuples.mechanism: a sharp sound made deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to the snap; a loud clean sound punctuates a quiet repetitive task

tuples.episode_object: a creased item set aside for ironing
tuples.time_place_scope: a folding session where not everything can be folded
tuples.mechanism: a decision made once and not revisited
tuples.evidence_lens: decide and move on; the re-deciding is what turns a chore into a burden

tuples.episode_object: the basket becoming visibly emptier
tuples.time_place_scope: the second half of a large load
tuples.mechanism: progress noticed rather than measured
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the basket, not the clock; the basket is honest and the clock is not helpful here

tuples.episode_object: a garment held up and checked
tuples.time_place_scope: a folding session with clothes that may need mending
tuples.mechanism: a brief inspection performed properly
tuples.evidence_lens: look at it once, all over; a proper look takes four seconds and is rarely given

tuples.episode_object: laundry hung on a rail rather than folded
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where some things go straight onto hangers
tuples.mechanism: a different action within the same task
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the change of movement; varying the action keeps a long task from disappearing

tuples.episode_object: the table's surface under the forearms
tuples.time_place_scope: a dining table used for folding
tuples.mechanism: a working surface noticed at the arms
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the table you are leaning on; furniture supports the body constantly and silently

tuples.episode_object: the last item in the basket
tuples.time_place_scope: the final fold of a full load
tuples.mechanism: an ending recognised as it arrives
tuples.evidence_lens: know that this is the last one while folding it; knowing changes the quality of the movement

tuples.episode_object: a drawer opened and a stack laid in
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom after the folding is finished
tuples.mechanism: putting away completed in one trip
tuples.evidence_lens: carry it all in one go and put it all away; a task that ends in the right place has actually ended

tuples.episode_object: an empty basket set back in its place
tuples.time_place_scope: the last action of a laundry session
tuples.mechanism: a container returned once emptied
tuples.evidence_lens: put the basket back rather than leaving it out; the last step is the one usually skipped

tuples.episode_object: the room quieter with the machine finished
tuples.time_place_scope: a utility space after the cycle has ended
tuples.mechanism: noticing a machine's absence of sound
tuples.evidence_lens: listen for the missing hum; the quiet arrived without being announced

tuples.episode_object: a peg opened between finger and thumb
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden line on a dry breezy morning
tuples.mechanism: a small resistance felt in the fingers
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the spring each time; a hundred small identical resistances make a task easy to stay inside

tuples.episode_object: a sheet filling with wind
tuples.time_place_scope: a washing line on a gusty afternoon
tuples.mechanism: watching air made visible by fabric
tuples.evidence_lens: the wind is invisible until the sheet shows it; watching the effect is easier than watching the cause

tuples.episode_object: damp cloth cold against the forearms
tuples.time_place_scope: a line being hung with a load straight from the machine
tuples.mechanism: cold and wet met at the skin
tuples.evidence_lens: one clear sensation, unpleasant or not; the practice does not require the sensation to be nice

tuples.episode_object: a basket set down on grass
tuples.time_place_scope: a lawn beside the line on a summer morning
tuples.mechanism: a load put down before the work starts
tuples.evidence_lens: set it down properly rather than dropping it; the first action sets the pace for the rest

tuples.episode_object: arms lifted above the head repeatedly
tuples.time_place_scope: a high line that requires reaching
tuples.mechanism: an overhead movement repeated
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the shoulders after ten items; the body accumulates and will tell you if asked

tuples.episode_object: the flap and crack of drying fabric
tuples.time_place_scope: a line already half full on a windy day
tuples.mechanism: an irregular sound listened to without pattern
tuples.evidence_lens: there is no rhythm to find, so stop looking for one; irregular sound is restful once that is accepted

tuples.episode_object: a shirt hung by its shoulders
tuples.time_place_scope: a line where each garment is hung a particular way
tuples.mechanism: a considered placement for each item
tuples.evidence_lens: hang each thing the way it dries best; small correctness done repeatedly is the practice

tuples.episode_object: a line prop lifted into place
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden where the line sags when full
tuples.mechanism: one strong deliberate movement
tuples.evidence_lens: lift it in one go and feel the weight transfer; a single effortful act punctuates a light task

tuples.episode_object: the sky checked for weather
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden under a mixed and changeable sky
tuples.mechanism: a judgement made from direct observation
tuples.evidence_lens: look up and decide yourself; using your own eyes instead of a forecast is a form of attention

tuples.episode_object: cold fingers after twenty pegs
tuples.time_place_scope: a line being hung on a bright winter day
tuples.mechanism: a gradual change noticed in the hands
tuples.evidence_lens: notice when the fingers stop working well; the body sets a limit and it is worth respecting

tuples.episode_object: a peg dropped into the grass
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden where things get lost underfoot
tuples.mechanism: a small interruption met without irritation
tuples.evidence_lens: bend, pick it up, carry on; the whole event is four seconds long and can be done well

tuples.episode_object: the smell of the garden while working
tuples.time_place_scope: a back garden after rain earlier in the day
tuples.mechanism: an outdoor smell noticed during an indoor-style task
tuples.evidence_lens: the chore is domestic and the air is not; noticing the mismatch is the pleasure

tuples.episode_object: items ordered by size along the line
tuples.time_place_scope: a line being filled from one end
tuples.mechanism: a simple system applied consistently
tuples.evidence_lens: choose a rule and follow it; the rule removes decisions and the removal is what rests

tuples.episode_object: a bird landing on the fence nearby
tuples.time_place_scope: a quiet garden with nobody else about
tuples.mechanism: a brief interruption welcomed
tuples.evidence_lens: stop, watch, resume; interruptions can be accepted rather than resisted, and it costs nothing

tuples.episode_object: the last item pegged up
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a full basket
tuples.mechanism: a completion noticed as it happens
tuples.evidence_lens: know it is the last one; endings are more satisfying when they are seen coming

tuples.episode_object: the empty basket carried back inside
tuples.time_place_scope: the walk from the line to the house
tuples.mechanism: a return journey taken slowly
tuples.evidence_lens: walk back at half speed; the task is done and there is nothing to hurry toward

tuples.episode_object: sun-warmed fabric taken down hours later
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden in the late afternoon of a dry day
tuples.mechanism: warmth found in something left outside
tuples.evidence_lens: press it to the face once; sun-dried cloth is a specific and short-lived sensation

tuples.episode_object: a stiff, air-dried towel
tuples.time_place_scope: a line brought in after a cold windy day
tuples.mechanism: an unexpected texture noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: notice how different it feels from machine-dried; comparisons are the quickest way to sharpen touch

tuples.episode_object: the line hanging empty
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden once everything has been taken in
tuples.mechanism: looking at a space that has been emptied
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the empty line for a moment; emptied spaces are worth the same attention as filled ones

tuples.episode_object: pegs returned to their bag
tuples.time_place_scope: the final tidying of an outdoor task
tuples.mechanism: small items gathered and stored
tuples.evidence_lens: collect every one; a small exhaustive task has a genuine and checkable end

tuples.episode_object: a broom handle held in both hands
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen floor at the end of the day
tuples.mechanism: a grip found and settled into
tuples.evidence_lens: find a comfortable hold before the first stroke; the grip determines the next five minutes

tuples.episode_object: bristles moving across stone tile
tuples.time_place_scope: a hard floor in a hallway
tuples.mechanism: a repeated sweeping rhythm
tuples.evidence_lens: let the strokes become even; evenness is audible and easy to check

tuples.episode_object: dust gathering into a visible line
tuples.time_place_scope: a floor partway through being swept
tuples.mechanism: watching a scattered thing become one thing
tuples.evidence_lens: watch the line grow; visible progress is the reason this task holds attention so well

tuples.episode_object: an awkward corner under a cupboard
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen with furniture close to the floor
tuples.mechanism: a difficult spot worked at deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: take the extra ten seconds; the corner nobody sees is where the attention is proved

tuples.episode_object: a dustpan held against the floor
tuples.time_place_scope: the collecting stage of sweeping
tuples.mechanism: two hands doing different jobs at once
tuples.evidence_lens: notice each hand separately; coordinated hands are usually invisible to their owner

tuples.episode_object: crumbs under a dining table
tuples.time_place_scope: a room after a family meal
tuples.mechanism: a known problem area addressed first
tuples.evidence_lens: start where the mess actually is; sensible order is itself a kind of calm

tuples.episode_object: the line of dust left after one pass
tuples.time_place_scope: a floor that needs a second sweep
tuples.mechanism: accepting that once is not enough
tuples.evidence_lens: go again without irritation; repetition is expected and not a sign of failure

tuples.episode_object: a rug lifted at one edge

tuples.time_place_scope: a garden at an hour when others are also awake
tuples.mechanism: a brief awareness of other people nearby
tuples.evidence_lens: notice that someone else is up too; a two-second thought, then back to the job

tuples.episode_object: frost crunching underfoot on the path
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden path on a very cold morning
tuples.mechanism: a sound made by your own steps
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to your own footfall; you are producing the sound and can change it at will

tuples.episode_object: the recycling box emptied and shaken out
tuples.time_place_scope: the bin area with the job nearly done
tuples.mechanism: a container emptied completely
tuples.evidence_lens: turn it fully over; the difference between mostly empty and empty is worth one extra second

tuples.episode_object: a bin dragged to the kerb
tuples.time_place_scope: a pavement on collection night
tuples.mechanism: a sustained pulling effort felt in the shoulder
tuples.evidence_lens: notice which shoulder is doing the work; switch sides if you want to, and notice that too

tuples.episode_object: rain met without a coat
tuples.time_place_scope: a quick trip outside during a shower
tuples.mechanism: brief discomfort accepted for a short task
tuples.evidence_lens: get wet and go back in; twenty seconds of rain is a fact rather than a problem

tuples.episode_object: the back door closed behind you
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of returning indoors
tuples.mechanism: a boundary crossed back the other way
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the warmth arriving; coming back in is more noticeable than going out

tuples.episode_object: hands washed after the bins
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen sink immediately afterwards
tuples.mechanism: a closing action that ends the task
tuples.evidence_lens: wash them properly; a small unpleasant task deserves a clean ending

tuples.episode_object: a kitchen with the bin now empty
tuples.time_place_scope: the room after the errand is finished
tuples.mechanism: noticing space that has been made
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the empty corner; the point of the errand is visible for about an hour

tuples.episode_object: a single shelf chosen out of many
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where everything could be tidied
tuples.mechanism: a boundary set before starting
tuples.evidence_lens: choose one shelf and say so out loud; the limit is the practice, not the tidying

tuples.episode_object: book spines pushed level with the edge
tuples.time_place_scope: a bookshelf in a living room
tuples.mechanism: alignment made by eye and hand
tuples.evidence_lens: line them up and then look along the row; the check is as satisfying as the doing

tuples.episode_object: dust along the front of a shelf
tuples.time_place_scope: a surface that has not been cleaned in months
tuples.mechanism: noticing accumulation before removing it
tuples.evidence_lens: look at it before wiping; seeing the before is what makes the after mean anything

tuples.episode_object: an object that has no obvious place
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf with something that does not belong there
tuples.mechanism: a decision made rather than deferred
tuples.evidence_lens: decide now, even imperfectly; an imperfect decision beats returning to this object next month

tuples.episode_object: a photograph found behind other things
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf being properly cleared for once
tuples.mechanism: an unexpected find handled briefly
tuples.evidence_lens: look at it for ten seconds, then continue; the boundary is what stops a tidy becoming an afternoon

tuples.episode_object: a cloth run along an emptied surface
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf with everything taken off it
tuples.mechanism: cleaning an area that is fully accessible
tuples.evidence_lens: empty it first, then clean; the order makes the work half as long and twice as thorough

tuples.episode_object: an item held while deciding to keep it
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf where something has not been used in years
tuples.mechanism: holding an object during a decision
tuples.evidence_lens: hold it, decide, and act; holding it while not deciding is what makes tidying tiring

tuples.episode_object: a stack of papers squared up
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf with loose documents on it
tuples.mechanism: loose things made into one thing
tuples.evidence_lens: square the edges; disorder becomes order through one small mechanical action

tuples.episode_object: a gap left deliberately empty
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf that could be filled but need not be
tuples.mechanism: choosing not to fill available space
tuples.evidence_lens: leave the gap on purpose; restraint is visible afterwards and it is the harder choice

tuples.episode_object: a small ornament set square
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf with one decorative object on it
tuples.mechanism: a final placement adjusted carefully
tuples.evidence_lens: move it a centimetre and see if it is better; caring about a centimetre is the whole exercise

tuples.episode_object: an item put back exactly where it was
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf where most things were already fine
tuples.mechanism: leaving well alone deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: put it back unchanged; recognising that nothing is needed is a real result

tuples.episode_object: a box lifted down and looked into
tuples.time_place_scope: a high shelf with something forgotten on it
tuples.mechanism: investigating rather than assuming
tuples.evidence_lens: open it and find out; assumptions about your own possessions are usually wrong

tuples.episode_object: a book returned to its right place
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf where things have drifted out of order
tuples.mechanism: one item restored to a system
tuples.evidence_lens: restore one thing; a system survives if it is repaired occasionally rather than rebuilt

tuples.episode_object: a shelf edge wiped underneath as well
tuples.time_place_scope: a tidy that is going slightly further than planned
tuples.mechanism: noticing scope beginning to expand
tuples.evidence_lens: catch the expansion and choose; the choice is what keeps this from becoming a whole day

tuples.episode_object: the temptation to start the next shelf
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment the chosen shelf is finished
tuples.mechanism: stopping at the agreed boundary
tuples.evidence_lens: stop where you said you would; stopping on time is a skill, and it is the one being practised

tuples.episode_object: things arranged by height
tuples.time_place_scope: a shelf being organised as well as cleaned
tuples.mechanism: a simple ordering rule applied
tuples.evidence_lens: choose one rule and use it throughout; the rule takes the decisions away

tuples.episode_object: an item taken away to be given up
tuples.time_place_scope: a tidy that produces one thing to let go of
tuples.mechanism: a single removal completed
tuples.evidence_lens: take it out of the room now; a thing still in the room has not been let go of

tuples.episode_object: the shelf seen from across the room
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of stepping back
tuples.mechanism: a wide look after close work
tuples.evidence_lens: look from a distance; close work always needs one look from far away to be believed

tuples.episode_object: the rest of the room left untidy
tuples.time_place_scope: a space where only one part has been dealt with
tuples.mechanism: accepting a partial result on purpose
tuples.evidence_lens: leave the rest without apology; partial done well is a legitimate finished state

tuples.episode_object: a cloth taken back to the kitchen
tuples.time_place_scope: the last action of a small tidying job
tuples.mechanism: a tool returned before the task counts as done
tuples.evidence_lens: take it back now; the walk to the kitchen is the last ten seconds of the practice

tuples.episode_object: a hand resting flat on a small back
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedside in the last minutes of the evening
tuples.mechanism: steady contact given without movement
tuples.evidence_lens: keep the hand still; stillness in a hand is felt immediately by the person under it

tuples.episode_object: the last page of a story
tuples.time_place_scope: a child's room with the reading finished
tuples.mechanism: an ending given its full weight
tuples.evidence_lens: read the last line slowly and close the book; the closing is part of the story

tuples.episode_object: a lamp turned down to its lowest setting
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom moving from evening into night
tuples.mechanism: gradual light lowering
tuples.evidence_lens: lower it in stages rather than switching it off; gradual change is easier for everyone in the room

tuples.episode_object: your own breathing beside the bed
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where a child is nearly asleep
tuples.mechanism: slowing your own breath where it can be heard
tuples.evidence_lens: slow your breathing and let it be audible; the pace in the room is set by whoever is calmest

tuples.episode_object: a blanket pulled up to the shoulders
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedside on a cold night
tuples.mechanism: one small act of physical care
tuples.evidence_lens: tuck it deliberately rather than absently; the difference is small and entirely perceptible

tuples.episode_object: a soft toy located and handed over
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedtime with one item that must be found
tuples.mechanism: a small search completed calmly
tuples.evidence_lens: look properly rather than impatiently; the search takes the same time either way

tuples.episode_object: a third request for water
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedtime that has already been extended twice
tuples.mechanism: noticing impatience during a repeated demand
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the impatience and answer anyway; naming it privately is what keeps it out of your voice

tuples.episode_object: the mattress edge under your weight
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedside where you have sat down to wait
tuples.mechanism: a contact point noticed while waiting
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the edge you are sitting on; the wait is long and the body is the thing that is here

tuples.episode_object: a nightlight's small steady glow
tuples.time_place_scope: a darkened room with one low light
tuples.mechanism: a single point of light rested on
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the light rather than the door; where you look is where the waiting happens

tuples.episode_object: a song hummed rather than sung
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedside where words would be too much
tuples.mechanism: volume and complexity deliberately reduced
tuples.evidence_lens: take the words out; less is the whole technique at this hour

tuples.episode_object: the sound of the house beyond the door
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom with the rest of the evening waiting
tuples.mechanism: noticing the pull toward what is next
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the wish to be downstairs; the wish and the sitting can happily coexist

tuples.episode_object: a curtain drawn fully closed
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom on a light summer evening
tuples.mechanism: one preparation completed properly
tuples.evidence_lens: close it all the way; the small gap is what will matter in twenty minutes

tuples.episode_object: a floorboard that creaks near the door
tuples.time_place_scope: a room being left as quietly as possible
tuples.mechanism: movement made carefully in a known space
tuples.evidence_lens: remember where it is and step around it; knowing your own house is a form of attention

tuples.episode_object: a child's breathing changing rhythm
tuples.time_place_scope: the minutes when sleep actually arrives
tuples.mechanism: listening for a change without willing it
tuples.evidence_lens: wait for the change rather than checking for it; it announces itself clearly when it comes

tuples.episode_object: the room's temperature checked by hand
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom on an unusually warm night
tuples.mechanism: a practical check made by touch
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the air rather than reading a thermostat; hands are adequate for this and always present

tuples.episode_object: a whispered goodnight
tuples.time_place_scope: the last exchange before leaving the room
tuples.mechanism: one short sentence said with full attention
tuples.evidence_lens: say it properly, not on the way out; four words given fully are a complete practice

tuples.episode_object: sitting on the floor beside the bed
tuples.time_place_scope: a night that needs someone in the room a while longer
tuples.mechanism: settling in rather than hovering
tuples.evidence_lens: sit down properly; hovering signals leaving and everyone in the room can feel it

tuples.episode_object: your own tiredness noticed at the bedside
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a long day with a long bedtime
tuples.mechanism: a caregiver's own state acknowledged
tuples.evidence_lens: notice your tiredness without resenting it; the noticing is for you and costs the child nothing

tuples.episode_object: a door left open a hand's width
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of leaving the room
tuples.mechanism: a small arrangement made to a known preference
tuples.evidence_lens: leave it exactly as they like it; the detail matters more to them than it does to you

tuples.episode_object: the landing outside a quiet room
tuples.time_place_scope: the first seconds after the door is pulled to
tuples.mechanism: a pause taken immediately after finishing
tuples.evidence_lens: stand still for one breath before going downstairs; the evening will still be there in five seconds

tuples.episode_object: a chair pulled up beside another chair
tuples.time_place_scope: a front room in the middle of a visit
tuples.mechanism: a position chosen for sitting alongside
tuples.evidence_lens: sit beside rather than opposite; the geometry of a room changes a conversation more than any topic

tuples.episode_object: the thin skin on the back of a hand
tuples.time_place_scope: a visit where hands are held for a while
tuples.mechanism: touch given without needing to speak
tuples.evidence_lens: hold without patting; steady contact says something that movement interrupts

tuples.episode_object: a story told for the third time this month
tuples.time_place_scope: a conversation that circles back to a familiar subject
tuples.mechanism: listening again to something already known
tuples.evidence_lens: listen for one detail you missed before; there is almost always one, and looking for it changes the hour

tuples.episode_object: a clock ticking in a quiet room
tuples.time_place_scope: a house where the clock is the loudest thing
tuples.mechanism: a steady sound accepted rather than resisted
tuples.evidence_lens: let the clock keep time instead of you; there is nothing else that needs timing

tuples.episode_object: two cups of tea going slowly cold
tuples.time_place_scope: a long visit with no particular agenda
tuples.mechanism: noticing time passing through an object
tuples.evidence_lens: touch the cup and know how long you have been sitting; the tea keeps a better record than you do

tuples.episode_object: a silence that neither of you fills
tuples.time_place_scope: a visit where the conversation has run out
tuples.mechanism: a shared pause allowed to stand
tuples.evidence_lens: do not fill it; a silence between two people who know each other is not an emptiness

tuples.episode_object: afternoon light across a carpet
tuples.time_place_scope: a sitting room in the hours after lunch
tuples.mechanism: a slow change of light noticed together
tuples.evidence_lens: mention it out loud once; something shared and unimportant is the easiest thing to share

tuples.episode_object: a blanket arranged over the knees
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where warmth matters more than it used to
tuples.mechanism: one small practical act of care
tuples.evidence_lens: arrange it as they prefer, not as you would; asking takes three seconds and settles the question

tuples.episode_object: a photograph on a sideboard
tuples.time_place_scope: a room full of long-standing objects
tuples.mechanism: asking about something rather than assuming
tuples.evidence_lens: ask a question you do not know the answer to; genuine questions change the shape of a visit

tuples.episode_object: the pace of a slow sentence
tuples.time_place_scope: a conversation where words arrive with gaps
tuples.mechanism: matching your speed to someone else's
tuples.evidence_lens: slow your own speech to theirs; matching is a physical adjustment and it is felt

tuples.episode_object: a radio playing quietly in the background
tuples.time_place_scope: a house where the radio is always on
tuples.mechanism: an ambient sound left where it is
tuples.evidence_lens: do not turn it off; the room was arranged before you arrived and can stay that way

tuples.episode_object: a hand offered for a slow walk to a chair
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where moving takes some time
tuples.mechanism: walking at another person's pace
tuples.evidence_lens: go at their speed the whole way; adjusting your stride is a plain and useful kindness

tuples.episode_object: the particular smell of a familiar house
tuples.time_place_scope: the first minutes after arriving
tuples.mechanism: a scent recognised on entering
tuples.evidence_lens: notice it in the first ten seconds; you will not smell it again for the rest of the visit

tuples.episode_object: a question asked twice within an hour
tuples.time_place_scope: a visit where memory is not what it was
tuples.mechanism: answering again without correcting
tuples.evidence_lens: answer as if for the first time; the second answer costs you nothing and gives a great deal

tuples.episode_object: the warmth of an over-heated room
tuples.time_place_scope: a house kept warmer than you would keep yours
tuples.mechanism: a mild discomfort accepted without comment
tuples.evidence_lens: notice it and say nothing; the room is for them and the noticing is for you

tuples.episode_object: a window looked at together
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where the view is a shared subject
tuples.mechanism: attention pointed at the same thing by two people
tuples.evidence_lens: look where they are looking; joint attention is companionship without any conversation

tuples.episode_object: a hand resting on a chair arm
tuples.time_place_scope: a visit where nothing much is happening
tuples.mechanism: noticing stillness in someone else
tuples.evidence_lens: observe without interpreting; a person at rest does not need to be assessed

tuples.episode_object: your own restlessness partway through
tuples.time_place_scope: a long visit with time still to go
tuples.mechanism: noticing the urge to leave
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the restlessness and stay a little longer; the noticing is honest and the staying is the choice

tuples.episode_object: a goodbye said while still seated
tuples.time_place_scope: the last minutes before leaving
tuples.mechanism: an ending begun before standing up
tuples.evidence_lens: say it before you stand; goodbyes said on the way out are the ones that feel rushed

tuples.episode_object: a door pulled shut on a quiet house
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of leaving after a visit
tuples.mechanism: a pause taken on the other side of the door
tuples.evidence_lens: stand outside for one breath; the visit deserves a moment before the rest of the day resumes

tuples.episode_object: the sound of dry food falling into a bowl
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen at the same time every morning
tuples.mechanism: a short distinctive sound attended to
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to the pouring; this exact sound happens once a day and is never actually heard

tuples.episode_object: a cat winding around both ankles
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen floor while the food is being prepared
tuples.mechanism: contact received rather than initiated
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the pressure against the legs; someone else is starting this contact and you only have to notice

tuples.episode_object: a dog sitting and waiting
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen where a routine is well established
tuples.mechanism: noticing another creature's patience
tuples.evidence_lens: watch the waiting for five seconds before putting the bowl down; the wait is theirs and it is remarkable

tuples.episode_object: a scoop lifted level and tipped
tuples.time_place_scope: a food bin in a utility cupboard
tuples.mechanism: a measured amount handled precisely
tuples.evidence_lens: level the scoop deliberately; a small precision performed daily is worth doing on purpose

tuples.episode_object: water changed rather than topped up
tuples.time_place_scope: a bowl that has been standing since yesterday
tuples.mechanism: a small task done properly instead of quickly
tuples.evidence_lens: empty it fully first; the difference between refilling and replacing is thirty seconds

tuples.episode_object: the noise of an animal eating fast
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen in the first minute after the bowl goes down
tuples.mechanism: an unruly sound accepted as it is
tuples.evidence_lens: do not tidy this sound in your mind; it is what it is and it lasts ninety seconds

tuples.episode_object: fur under the flat of a hand
tuples.time_place_scope: a moment beside an animal that has finished eating
tuples.mechanism: texture felt with a whole palm
tuples.evidence_lens: use the palm rather than the fingertips; a broad contact reports differently and takes no more time

tuples.episode_object: a food bin lid pressed closed
tuples.time_place_scope: the tidying step at the end of feeding
tuples.mechanism: one closure completed properly
tuples.evidence_lens: press until it seals; small closures done fully are the difference between a routine and a mess

tuples.episode_object: an old animal eating more slowly than before
tuples.time_place_scope: a household where a pet has grown older
tuples.mechanism: noticing change over a long period
tuples.evidence_lens: observe the pace without conclusion; noticing is complete on its own and needs no plan attached

tuples.episode_object: a feeding mat straightened on the floor
tuples.time_place_scope: a corner of the kitchen kept for this purpose
tuples.mechanism: a small arrangement corrected
