tuples.evidence_lens: square it up; the mat does not care and the straightening is entirely for the attention it takes

tuples.episode_object: seed scattered on a bird table
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden on a cold morning
tuples.mechanism: a task done for creatures you will not see eating
tuples.evidence_lens: scatter it and walk away; care given without witnessing the result is a particular kind of quiet

tuples.episode_object: flakes tapped onto the surface of a tank
tuples.time_place_scope: a room with a fish tank in the corner
tuples.mechanism: a very small quantity handled carefully
tuples.evidence_lens: tap gently and watch the surface; the whole event lasts ten seconds and rewards close looking

tuples.episode_object: a hutch door unlatched and opened
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden or shed with an outdoor animal
tuples.mechanism: a mechanism operated slowly to avoid startling
tuples.evidence_lens: open it more slowly than needed; the slowness is for them and the noticing is for you

tuples.episode_object: paws sounding on a hard floor
tuples.time_place_scope: a hallway as an animal comes to be fed
tuples.mechanism: an approach heard before it is seen
tuples.evidence_lens: listen for the arrival; sound reaches you before sight does and it is rarely used

tuples.episode_object: a bowl washed before refilling
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen sink during the feeding routine
tuples.mechanism: an extra step taken for cleanliness
tuples.evidence_lens: wash it properly; the step is optional today and that is exactly why it counts

tuples.episode_object: the same routine performed at the same hour
tuples.time_place_scope: a household where the timing never varies
tuples.mechanism: noticing a habit while performing it
tuples.evidence_lens: catch yourself doing something you have done a thousand times; the count itself is worth a thought

tuples.episode_object: an animal looking up mid-meal
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen where you have stayed to watch
tuples.mechanism: a brief exchange of attention
tuples.evidence_lens: meet the look and let it be brief; two seconds of mutual attention is a complete event

tuples.episode_object: an empty bowl on the floor afterwards
tuples.time_place_scope: the kitchen a few minutes after feeding
tuples.mechanism: a finished state noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: see the empty bowl; the task had a beginning and this is unambiguously its end

tuples.episode_object: hands washed after handling food
tuples.time_place_scope: a sink immediately after the feeding is done
tuples.mechanism: a closing hygiene step done attentively
tuples.evidence_lens: take the full twenty seconds; a routine handwash is a routine minute of attention

tuples.episode_object: a quiet kitchen once the eating stops
tuples.time_place_scope: the room after an animal has wandered off
tuples.mechanism: noticing a return to stillness
tuples.evidence_lens: stand in the quiet for one breath; the noise was brief and so is the silence that follows it

tuples.episode_object: both feet pressed into the floor
tuples.time_place_scope: the minutes before a conversation you are dreading
tuples.mechanism: breath pacing with the feet grounded
tuples.evidence_lens: feet first, then breath; the order matters because the body is easier to reach than the mind

tuples.episode_object: an intention written in one sentence
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk shortly before a difficult meeting
tuples.mechanism: a values reminder put into words
tuples.evidence_lens: write what you want to be like, not what you want to happen; only one of those is yours to decide

tuples.episode_object: a hand resting on a door handle
tuples.time_place_scope: the corridor outside the room where it will happen
tuples.mechanism: a pause taken at the last possible moment
tuples.evidence_lens: one breath with the hand already there; there is always time for one breath

tuples.episode_object: a glass of water drunk beforehand
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen or office before a hard exchange
tuples.mechanism: one simple physical act before a complex one
tuples.evidence_lens: do something easy and concrete first; it steadies the hands more than rehearsal does

tuples.episode_object: the wish to postpone it again
tuples.time_place_scope: a day where this has already been put off twice
tuples.mechanism: noticing avoidance clearly
tuples.evidence_lens: name the avoidance out loud if you can; naming it is the only reliable way past it

tuples.episode_object: a first sentence chosen in advance
tuples.time_place_scope: the last minutes of preparation
tuples.mechanism: one thing decided so the rest can be improvised
tuples.evidence_lens: prepare only the opening; over-scripting is what makes conversations go badly

tuples.episode_object: a car park before going into the building
tuples.time_place_scope: a few minutes alone before an appointment
tuples.mechanism: a private pause taken in a vehicle
tuples.evidence_lens: stay in the car for two minutes; a parked car is one of the few private places most days offer

tuples.episode_object: a jaw held tight without noticing
tuples.time_place_scope: the build-up to a conversation about something serious
tuples.mechanism: physical tension located before it is spoken through
tuples.evidence_lens: find the tension and let the teeth part; a loose jaw changes a voice audibly

tuples.episode_object: the other person's likely point of view
tuples.time_place_scope: the quiet minutes before the exchange begins
tuples.mechanism: attention turned briefly outward
tuples.evidence_lens: spend thirty seconds on their side; this is preparation, not concession

tuples.episode_object: notes folded and put in a pocket
tuples.time_place_scope: a preparation that is now finished
tuples.mechanism: stopping preparation deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: put the notes away before going in; more preparation past this point makes things worse, not better

tuples.episode_object: a phone about to ring at an agreed time
tuples.time_place_scope: the last minute before a scheduled difficult call
tuples.mechanism: waiting for something you did not want to arrive
tuples.evidence_lens: sit with the waiting rather than filling it; the call will come at the time it was going to come

tuples.episode_object: a chair chosen in an empty meeting room
tuples.time_place_scope: a room arrived at early on purpose
tuples.mechanism: a small choice made while you still can
tuples.evidence_lens: choose where you sit; small controllable things are worth taking when large ones are not available

tuples.episode_object: shoulders lifted toward the ears
tuples.time_place_scope: a corridor walk toward a hard conversation
tuples.mechanism: a posture noticed and allowed to drop
tuples.evidence_lens: let them down on one out-breath; if they rise again, that is expected and not a failure

tuples.episode_object: a clock showing five minutes left
tuples.time_place_scope: an office in the final wait
tuples.mechanism: a countable wait used rather than endured
tuples.evidence_lens: use the five minutes rather than watching them; watching makes them longer and worse

tuples.episode_object: a face seen briefly in a mirror
tuples.time_place_scope: a washroom before going into the room
tuples.mechanism: a look taken without self-assessment
tuples.evidence_lens: look once, without deciding anything about what you see; this is not the moment for a verdict

tuples.episode_object: the sound of your own voice tested quietly
tuples.time_place_scope: a private space before speaking to someone
tuples.mechanism: noticing what the voice is doing before it matters
tuples.evidence_lens: say one ordinary sentence aloud; the voice reports the state of the body accurately

tuples.episode_object: a window in a corridor
tuples.time_place_scope: the walk between preparation and arrival
tuples.mechanism: a distant look taken on the way
tuples.evidence_lens: look outside once on the way; the world is larger than the next twenty minutes and it is briefly visible

tuples.episode_object: a chair sat down in without hurrying
tuples.time_place_scope: the first seconds inside the room
tuples.mechanism: an entrance made at a chosen pace
tuples.evidence_lens: sit down slowly; the first ten seconds set the pace for what follows

tuples.episode_object: the first breath after saying hello
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment the conversation has actually begun
tuples.mechanism: one breath taken after the hardest part starts
tuples.evidence_lens: breathe once after the greeting, before the substance; the gap is small and nobody will notice it but you

tuples.episode_object: a decision to stop preparing and begin
tuples.time_place_scope: the final second before speaking
tuples.mechanism: an ending to the waiting chosen actively
tuples.evidence_lens: start because you decided to, not because the silence forced it; the difference is felt on both sides

tuples.episode_object: the front door closed on the last goodbye
tuples.time_place_scope: a hallway at the end of an evening with visitors
tuples.mechanism: a boundary closed after a busy few hours
tuples.evidence_lens: stand at the closed door for one breath; the change from full house to empty one is instant and worth catching

tuples.episode_object: chairs left where people pushed them
tuples.time_place_scope: a dining room immediately after everyone has gone
tuples.mechanism: reading a room by what has been left behind
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the arrangement before changing it; the room is a record of the evening for about ten more minutes

tuples.episode_object: glasses standing at different levels
tuples.time_place_scope: a table not yet cleared
tuples.mechanism: noticing an ordinary scene before tidying it away
tuples.evidence_lens: see it as it is; it will not look like this again and it takes five seconds to notice

tuples.episode_object: the absence of several voices
tuples.time_place_scope: a living room in the first minute of emptiness
tuples.mechanism: noticing a sound that has stopped
tuples.evidence_lens: listen for what is gone; loud absences are the easiest kind to notice

tuples.episode_object: a cushion pushed into a corner
tuples.time_place_scope: a sofa where people were sitting close together
tuples.mechanism: one object returned to its place
tuples.evidence_lens: straighten one thing only, then stop; a single act now is worth more than a full tidy at midnight

tuples.episode_object: the smell of the meal still in the house
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen an hour after everyone has eaten
tuples.mechanism: a lingering smell noticed before it fades
tuples.evidence_lens: notice it now; by tomorrow it will have gone entirely unremarked

tuples.episode_object: a window opened onto cool evening air
tuples.time_place_scope: a warm room that has held a lot of people
tuples.mechanism: air changed at the end of a gathering
tuples.evidence_lens: open it and stand there while the air moves; the room is doing something and you can watch it

tuples.episode_object: a coat left behind on a hook
tuples.time_place_scope: a hallway with one forgotten item
tuples.mechanism: a small unfinished thread noticed calmly
tuples.evidence_lens: note it and leave it; the message about it can be sent tomorrow

tuples.episode_object: your own tiredness arriving all at once
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment the last guest is out of sight
tuples.mechanism: a state noticed the instant it is allowed
tuples.evidence_lens: let the tiredness arrive without acting on it; it was there for an hour and was simply postponed

tuples.episode_object: a chair sat in without doing anything
tuples.time_place_scope: a living room with the clearing up still to do
tuples.mechanism: a deliberate pause before the tidying
tuples.evidence_lens: sit for two minutes first; the washing up is not going anywhere and this window closes

tuples.episode_object: a conversation replaying in your head
tuples.time_place_scope: a quiet kitchen while the dishes wait
tuples.mechanism: noticing thought without following it
tuples.evidence_lens: see that the evening is being rerun; noticing the rerun is enough and stopping it is not required

tuples.episode_object: a dishwasher door opened onto an empty rack
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen at the start of clearing up
tuples.mechanism: the first step of a task begun deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: open it and load one item; starting is the whole difficulty and one item ends it

tuples.episode_object: crumbs on a tablecloth
tuples.time_place_scope: a table where a meal was eaten several hours ago
tuples.mechanism: a small mess looked at before it is dealt with
tuples.evidence_lens: see the evidence of people eating together; it is a pleasant thing to look at for a moment

tuples.episode_object: a light switched from bright to low
tuples.time_place_scope: a room changing from social to private
tuples.mechanism: lighting adjusted to match a change of purpose
tuples.evidence_lens: change the light deliberately; the room's job has changed and the light can say so

tuples.episode_object: leftover food covered and put away
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen with more than was eaten
tuples.mechanism: one practical task completed fully
tuples.evidence_lens: do this one thing properly tonight; the rest can wait until the morning without cost

tuples.episode_object: standing in the middle of an empty room
tuples.time_place_scope: a space that was crowded an hour ago
tuples.mechanism: stillness taken in a room that has emptied
tuples.evidence_lens: stand where people were standing; the contrast is the whole practice and it requires nothing

tuples.episode_object: a shoe moved back to the rack
tuples.time_place_scope: a hallway where things have been displaced
tuples.mechanism: restoring one small arrangement
tuples.evidence_lens: put one thing back; the house returns to itself one object at a time

tuples.episode_object: the sound of the house's own systems
tuples.time_place_scope: a quiet home late in the evening
tuples.mechanism: noticing background sound after social noise
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to the fridge and the pipes; these were audible all evening and were completely masked

tuples.episode_object: a decision to leave the rest until morning
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen with clearing still undone
tuples.mechanism: a limit set on the evening's work
tuples.evidence_lens: decide, then actually stop; the deciding only counts if the stopping follows

tuples.episode_object: a hallway light switched off on the way up
tuples.time_place_scope: the last action of the night
tuples.mechanism: one closing act ending the day
tuples.evidence_lens: one switch, one breath; the evening is over and the house has been told

coverage_profiles.subject: a phone call with someone far away

tuples.episode_object: a name selected before pressing call
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment before dialling someone you have not spoken to in weeks
tuples.mechanism: a pause taken before initiating contact
tuples.evidence_lens: one breath before the ring starts; the call will go better and the breath costs nothing

tuples.episode_object: the first sound of a familiar voice
tuples.time_place_scope: the second the call connects
tuples.mechanism: recognition noticed as it happens
tuples.evidence_lens: notice what recognising a voice feels like; it is instant and almost never observed

tuples.episode_object: a half-second delay on the line
tuples.time_place_scope: a call across several time zones
tuples.mechanism: an imposed pause in a conversation
tuples.evidence_lens: let the delay be a rhythm rather than a fault; it slows the exchange and that is not a loss

tuples.episode_object: background sound from their room
tuples.time_place_scope: a call where the other person is at home
tuples.mechanism: listening past the voice to the place
tuples.evidence_lens: hear their kitchen or their street; you are briefly somewhere else and it costs no effort

tuples.episode_object: a window looked at while listening
tuples.time_place_scope: a long call with more listening than talking
tuples.mechanism: eyes resting while the ears work
tuples.evidence_lens: let the eyes settle somewhere plain; occupied ears leave the eyes free and they usually go to a screen

tuples.episode_object: walking slowly while talking
tuples.time_place_scope: a call taken in a room with space to pace
tuples.mechanism: movement allowed during conversation
tuples.evidence_lens: walk at half your usual speed; pacing is fine and slow pacing is better

tuples.episode_object: a silence neither of you rushes to fill
tuples.time_place_scope: a call where the news has been exchanged
tuples.mechanism: a pause allowed to stand at a distance
tuples.evidence_lens: let three seconds pass; silence on a phone feels longer than it is and is usually fine

tuples.episode_object: news that needs a moment before replying
tuples.time_place_scope: a call where something significant is said
tuples.mechanism: a considered pause before responding
tuples.evidence_lens: take the pause even though it is audible; a considered answer is worth an awkward second

tuples.episode_object: a laugh at something only the two of you understand
tuples.time_place_scope: a call with someone you have known a long time
tuples.mechanism: a shared moment noticed while it happens
tuples.evidence_lens: notice it as it occurs rather than afterwards; these are the parts that get remembered

tuples.episode_object: the phone growing warm against the ear
tuples.time_place_scope: a call that has run longer than expected
tuples.mechanism: a physical sign of elapsed time
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the warmth and know how long you have talked; the device keeps the time for you

tuples.episode_object: a time difference calculated in your head
tuples.time_place_scope: a call to someone whose day is at a different point
tuples.mechanism: holding two places in mind at once
tuples.evidence_lens: picture their light, not yours; it is a small act of imagination and it changes the conversation

tuples.episode_object: a promise to call again next week
tuples.time_place_scope: the closing minutes of the conversation
tuples.mechanism: a commitment made deliberately rather than politely
tuples.evidence_lens: mean it or do not say it; a specific day is worth more than a vague intention

tuples.episode_object: the line breaking up briefly
tuples.time_place_scope: a call with a poor connection
tuples.mechanism: an interruption met without frustration
tuples.evidence_lens: wait rather than repeating immediately; most breakups resolve within three seconds

tuples.episode_object: a photograph mentioned but not sent
tuples.time_place_scope: a conversation that references something visual
tuples.mechanism: describing rather than showing
tuples.evidence_lens: describe it in words; describing something out loud requires looking at it properly first

tuples.episode_object: a chair sat in for the whole call
tuples.time_place_scope: a call taken sitting down rather than while doing other things
tuples.mechanism: single-tasking a conversation
tuples.evidence_lens: do nothing else while talking; this is rare enough that the other person will notice

tuples.episode_object: a goodbye that takes several attempts
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a long overdue conversation
tuples.mechanism: noticing the reluctance to end something
tuples.evidence_lens: observe the third goodbye; the reluctance is affection and it is worth recognising as such

tuples.episode_object: the screen going dark after the call ends
tuples.time_place_scope: the seconds after hanging up
tuples.mechanism: an ending watched to completion
tuples.evidence_lens: watch the screen dim rather than immediately opening something else; the call gets three more seconds

tuples.episode_object: the room as it was before the call
tuples.time_place_scope: the space you were in the whole time
tuples.mechanism: returning attention to the present room
tuples.evidence_lens: look around the room you never left; you have been somewhere else for half an hour

tuples.episode_object: something you meant to say and did not
tuples.time_place_scope: the minutes after the conversation is over
tuples.mechanism: noticing an omission without repairing it now
tuples.evidence_lens: note it for next time and let it go; sending it as a message immediately is usually the worse option

tuples.episode_object: a phone set down face-up on a table
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment the call is fully finished
tuples.mechanism: a device put down rather than kept in hand
tuples.evidence_lens: put it down and leave it; the call is over and the phone does not need holding

tuples.episode_object: a doorstep beneath both feet
tuples.time_place_scope: the outside of your own front door
tuples.mechanism: a pause taken before entering
tuples.evidence_lens: stand on the step for one breath before opening anything; the step is a real place and it is on your way

tuples.episode_object: a porch light already on
tuples.time_place_scope: an arrival home after dark
tuples.mechanism: noticing something prepared for you
tuples.evidence_lens: see that someone or something expected you; a small fact, noticed once

tuples.episode_object: a doorframe touched with one hand
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of stepping through the entrance
tuples.mechanism: contact made with the boundary itself
tuples.evidence_lens: touch the frame as you pass; a threshold you touch is a threshold you notice

tuples.episode_object: the weight of the front door swinging
tuples.time_place_scope: an entrance with a heavy door
tuples.mechanism: a mass moved and controlled
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the door's weight rather than pushing through it; the door is the heaviest thing you will move today

tuples.episode_object: the step up into the hallway
tuples.time_place_scope: a house with a raised threshold
tuples.mechanism: a change of level noticed in the legs
tuples.evidence_lens: take the step deliberately; a small climb is a physical marker of arriving

tuples.episode_object: a hall radiator's warmth on the hands
tuples.time_place_scope: an entrance hall on a cold evening
tuples.mechanism: warmth sought out on arrival
tuples.evidence_lens: hold the hands there for ten seconds; the cold outside makes this unusually vivid

tuples.episode_object: the sound of the house from the doorway
tuples.time_place_scope: the first second of standing inside
tuples.mechanism: listening to a space before entering it fully
tuples.evidence_lens: stand still and listen once; every house has a sound and it is only audible on arrival

tuples.episode_object: voices heard from another room
tuples.time_place_scope: a home where other people are already in
tuples.mechanism: noticing others before joining them
tuples.evidence_lens: hear them before calling out; one breath first makes the greeting a better one

tuples.episode_object: an umbrella shaken out in the porch
tuples.time_place_scope: a sheltered entrance during rain
tuples.mechanism: a task completed at the boundary
tuples.evidence_lens: finish the outdoor business outdoors; the boundary works better when it is respected

tuples.episode_object: a jacket zip pulled all the way down
tuples.time_place_scope: the first moment inside a warm hallway
tuples.mechanism: one continuous movement felt from top to bottom
tuples.evidence_lens: pull it slowly and feel the whole length; simple mechanical actions are the easiest to attend to

tuples.episode_object: a dark hallway ahead
tuples.time_place_scope: arriving home to an unlit house
tuples.mechanism: a moment in the dark before reaching for the switch
tuples.evidence_lens: wait two seconds before the light; the dark is not a problem and the pause is available

tuples.episode_object: a letterbox flap resettling
tuples.time_place_scope: a front door that has just been closed
tuples.mechanism: a small sound heard after a larger one
tuples.evidence_lens: listen after the door closes; the small sound comes second and is usually missed

tuples.episode_object: the door handle's cold metal
tuples.time_place_scope: an entrance on a frosty evening
tuples.mechanism: temperature met at the point of entry
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the cold in the hand as you turn it; the handle is the last outdoor thing you touch

tuples.episode_object: a hallway rug's edge underfoot
tuples.time_place_scope: the first steps into the house
tuples.mechanism: a change of surface felt through the shoes
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the floor change; the house announces itself underfoot before it does anything else

tuples.episode_object: a spare key returned to its hiding place
tuples.time_place_scope: an arrival where the usual key was not to hand
tuples.mechanism: a small correction made immediately
tuples.evidence_lens: put it back now rather than later; the small step avoided tonight is tomorrow's problem

tuples.episode_object: the porch's shelter from the weather
tuples.time_place_scope: a doorway during heavy rain
tuples.mechanism: noticing a change from exposed to sheltered
tuples.evidence_lens: stand in the dry for a moment before going in; the porch is doing something and it can be felt

tuples.episode_object: one foot inside and one still out
tuples.time_place_scope: the exact moment of the threshold
tuples.mechanism: a boundary held rather than crossed quickly
tuples.evidence_lens: pause with the body in two places; this is briefly and literally true and it is worth a second

tuples.episode_object: the smell of your own home
tuples.time_place_scope: the first breath inside after time away
tuples.mechanism: a familiar smell recognised on return
tuples.evidence_lens: notice it in the first three seconds; your own house has a smell you can only detect on arrival

tuples.episode_object: a hallway light switched on
tuples.time_place_scope: the second after stepping fully inside
tuples.mechanism: one deliberate change made to a room
tuples.evidence_lens: switch it on knowingly; the first action inside sets the tone for the next hour

tuples.episode_object: the door closed and the outside shut out
tuples.time_place_scope: the completion of the arrival
tuples.mechanism: a crossing finished and marked
tuples.evidence_lens: let the closing door be the end of the journey; the journey needs an announced ending or it continues

tuples.episode_object: a window halfway up a flight
tuples.time_place_scope: a stairwell landing between two floors
tuples.mechanism: a pause taken at a natural stopping point
tuples.evidence_lens: the landing exists to break the climb; use it for one breath as well as for the turn

tuples.episode_object: a handrail worn smooth by use
tuples.time_place_scope: an old building's staircase
tuples.mechanism: noticing wear made by many hands
tuples.evidence_lens: feel where it is smoothest; a lot of people have held this exact place

tuples.episode_object: breath coming faster after a climb
tuples.time_place_scope: the top of a long flight of stairs
tuples.mechanism: noticing the breath without regulating it
tuples.evidence_lens: let it settle at its own rate; watching the recovery is easier than controlling the breath

tuples.episode_object: the view straight down the stairwell
tuples.time_place_scope: a landing in a tall building
tuples.mechanism: looking through a space rather than at a thing
tuples.evidence_lens: look down the shaft once; the geometry is unusual and the eyes have to work to read it

tuples.episode_object: footsteps echoing from another floor
tuples.time_place_scope: a quiet stairwell with someone else in it
tuples.mechanism: sound placed in space by listening
tuples.evidence_lens: guess where they are from the sound alone; hearing does this constantly and is rarely consulted

tuples.episode_object: a fire door held on its closer
tuples.time_place_scope: a landing with a heavy self-closing door
tuples.mechanism: a controlled resistance felt in the arm
tuples.evidence_lens: let it close at its own speed; the door has a mechanism and it is worth feeling once

tuples.episode_object: cold air in an unheated stairwell
tuples.time_place_scope: a block of flats in winter
tuples.mechanism: a temperature difference noticed between spaces
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the change between corridor and stairs; buildings have climates and the boundaries are sharp

tuples.episode_object: the edge of a step under the ball of the foot
tuples.time_place_scope: a staircase being climbed carefully
tuples.mechanism: foot placement attended to
tuples.evidence_lens: place each foot fully; stairs are one of the few places the feet are naturally attended to

tuples.episode_object: light falling from a rooflight above
tuples.time_place_scope: a stairwell lit from the top
tuples.mechanism: a light source located by looking
tuples.evidence_lens: find where the light comes from; the answer is usually above and rarely looked for

tuples.episode_object: a potted plant left on a landing
tuples.time_place_scope: a shared stairwell in a residential building
tuples.mechanism: noticing a small act by a neighbour
tuples.evidence_lens: someone put that there; two seconds of noticing another person's care

tuples.episode_object: a turn in the stairs at ninety degrees
tuples.time_place_scope: the corner of a dog-leg staircase
tuples.mechanism: a change of direction felt in the body
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the turn as a turn; the body rotates and it can be felt if you are looking for it

tuples.episode_object: a stair carpet's worn centre
tuples.time_place_scope: a domestic staircase in a house lived in for years
tuples.mechanism: noticing a path made by repetition
tuples.evidence_lens: see where everyone walks; the carpet has recorded thousands of journeys

tuples.episode_object: the last flight before your floor
tuples.time_place_scope: a climb nearly finished
tuples.mechanism: noticing the wish to be at the top
tuples.evidence_lens: catch the mind arriving before the legs; bring it back for the last few steps

tuples.episode_object: a bannister followed with the whole hand
tuples.time_place_scope: a descent taken carefully
tuples.mechanism: continuous contact maintained on the way down
tuples.evidence_lens: keep the hand in contact all the way; a continuous touch is a continuous anchor

tuples.episode_object: a landing that smells of the building
tuples.time_place_scope: a stairwell in an older block
tuples.mechanism: a smell noticed in a transitional space
tuples.evidence_lens: notice it in passing; corridors and stairwells have smells that rooms do not

tuples.episode_object: a fire notice on the wall
tuples.time_place_scope: a landing with the usual building signage
tuples.mechanism: reading something you have walked past a hundred times
tuples.evidence_lens: read it once, properly; the familiar becomes visible the moment it is read rather than seen

tuples.episode_object: someone passing on the stairs
tuples.time_place_scope: a narrow staircase with two people on it
tuples.mechanism: a brief coordinated movement with a stranger
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the small negotiation; it happens without words and takes about a second

tuples.episode_object: a radiator on a cold landing
tuples.time_place_scope: a stairwell where one spot is warm
tuples.mechanism: a small warm place found in a cold space
tuples.evidence_lens: stand beside it for a moment; the contrast is what makes it noticeable at all

tuples.episode_object: the sound of your own steps changing on the landing
tuples.time_place_scope: the flat section between two flights
tuples.mechanism: a change of rhythm noticed underfoot
tuples.evidence_lens: hear the rhythm break and reform; the landing sounds different from the stairs

tuples.episode_object: the last step onto a corridor floor
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of the climb
tuples.mechanism: an arrival marked at a change of surface
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the level ground; the climb is over and the body registers it immediately

coverage_profiles.subject: sitting down after standing all day

tuples.episode_object: the first contact between chair and body
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of sitting at the end of a long shift
tuples.mechanism: a change of state felt in one second
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the first second only; the relief is at its strongest immediately and then fades

tuples.episode_object: socks peeled off at the ankle
tuples.time_place_scope: a chair at home after a day on your feet
tuples.mechanism: a covering removed and the skin noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the air on the feet; a small change that is very easy to detect

tuples.episode_object: calves aching from hours of standing
tuples.time_place_scope: an armchair at the end of the working day
tuples.mechanism: an ache located precisely rather than generally
tuples.evidence_lens: say where it is; precision converts a vague tiredness into a specific fact

tuples.episode_object: the whole weight given over to a chair
tuples.time_place_scope: a comfortable seat with nothing else to do
tuples.mechanism: releasing effort that is no longer needed
tuples.evidence_lens: let the chair take everything; the muscles were holding you up and can now stop

tuples.episode_object: feet raised onto a footstool
tuples.time_place_scope: a living room in the evening
tuples.mechanism: a change of position made deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: raise them on purpose and notice the difference; elevation changes the legs within a minute

tuples.episode_object: the ankles rotated slowly
tuples.time_place_scope: a seat taken after a day of walking
tuples.mechanism: a small joint moved after a long stillness
tuples.evidence_lens: circle them both ways; the ankles have been working all day and rarely get asked about it

tuples.episode_object: a chair arm under the forearm
tuples.time_place_scope: an armchair in the first minutes of sitting
tuples.mechanism: a supported limb noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: let the arms be supported too; people sit down and keep holding their arms up out of habit

tuples.episode_object: a lower back settling against a backrest
tuples.time_place_scope: a chair with proper support after hours without any
tuples.mechanism: the spine allowed to rest
tuples.evidence_lens: lean back fully; perching on the edge is what the body does when it expects to get up again

tuples.episode_object: the wish to get up again to do one more thing
tuples.time_place_scope: the first two minutes of sitting down
tuples.mechanism: noticing an urge to interrupt a rest
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the urge and stay seated for two more minutes; the task will still be there

tuples.episode_object: a bus seat found after a long wait
tuples.time_place_scope: a journey home at the end of a shift
tuples.mechanism: rest taken wherever it becomes available
tuples.evidence_lens: take the rest that is offered; it does not have to be a good chair to be a real rest

tuples.episode_object: a kitchen stool used for five minutes
tuples.time_place_scope: a workplace where sitting is not really allowed
tuples.mechanism: a short rest fitted into a standing job
tuples.evidence_lens: five minutes counts; the practice does not require an armchair or an evening

tuples.episode_object: a warm bath taken after a hard day
tuples.time_place_scope: a bathroom in the evening
tuples.mechanism: whole-body warmth met at once
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the first ten seconds; after that the body adapts and the sensation flattens

tuples.episode_object: the floor sat on with the back against a wall
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where the floor is the nearest available seat
tuples.mechanism: a hard surface used deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: the floor is a valid seat; the practice never specified furniture

tuples.episode_object: a cushion pulled behind the shoulders
tuples.time_place_scope: a sofa being adjusted for comfort
tuples.mechanism: one adjustment made rather than endured
tuples.evidence_lens: fix the discomfort rather than sitting through it; adjusting is a form of attention to yourself

tuples.episode_object: shoulders dropping once the legs stop working
tuples.time_place_scope: the first minute in a chair after a long day
tuples.mechanism: noticing tension leave a part that was not obviously tense
tuples.evidence_lens: check the shoulders, not the legs; the surprise is usually up there

tuples.episode_object: the sound of a room with you finally still in it
tuples.time_place_scope: a home in the quiet after arriving and sitting
tuples.mechanism: listening once the moving has stopped
tuples.evidence_lens: listen now that you are not making any noise; the room has been quieter than you all day

tuples.episode_object: a heel rubbed where a shoe pressed
tuples.time_place_scope: a chair with the shoes just removed
tuples.mechanism: a small self-directed act of care
tuples.evidence_lens: attend to the place that hurts; it takes twenty seconds and the feet did the whole day

tuples.episode_object: a glass of water within reach
tuples.time_place_scope: a rest that will last a while
tuples.mechanism: preparing to stay rather than to get up
tuples.evidence_lens: bring what you need before sitting; the preparation is what makes the rest last

tuples.episode_object: the tiredness felt as heaviness rather than pain
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a physically demanding day
tuples.mechanism: a sensation described accurately
tuples.evidence_lens: find the right word for it; describing accurately is more useful than describing dramatically

tuples.episode_object: standing up again after ten minutes
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a deliberate rest
tuples.mechanism: a rest ended by decision rather than by interruption
tuples.evidence_lens: get up because you chose to; a rest that ends on your terms actually counts as one

tuples.episode_object: a pebbled neighbourhood footpath
tuples.time_place_scope: a short outdoor loop close to home
tuples.mechanism: paced five-sense scan
tuples.evidence_lens: one sense at a time, roughly a minute each; the order matters less than the separation

tuples.episode_object: a rough patch of tree bark
tuples.time_place_scope: midway along a familiar walking route
tuples.mechanism: comparing one tactile detail with another
tuples.evidence_lens: touch two different trees and compare; comparison is what makes touch report clearly

tuples.episode_object: the underside of a low leaf
tuples.time_place_scope: a hedgerow path in late spring
tuples.mechanism: looking at something from below
tuples.evidence_lens: crouch or lift it; a change of angle is a change of attention and costs one movement

tuples.episode_object: the smell of bread from a bakery
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk that passes a shop in the morning
tuples.mechanism: a strong smell followed to its source
tuples.evidence_lens: notice it before you identify it; the gap between smelling and naming is very short and interesting

tuples.episode_object: birdsong from an unseen bird
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk through a residential street with trees
tuples.mechanism: locating a sound without seeing it
tuples.evidence_lens: point to where you think it is; hearing has a spatial answer and it is fun to test

tuples.episode_object: wind directly on the face
tuples.time_place_scope: an open stretch of the walk
tuples.mechanism: air felt on exposed skin
tuples.evidence_lens: turn into the wind for five seconds; the face is the most sensitive skin you can easily expose

tuples.episode_object: a brick wall warm from the afternoon
tuples.time_place_scope: a south-facing wall in late summer
tuples.mechanism: stored heat found in a solid object
tuples.evidence_lens: put a hand on it; walls hold the day's heat and almost nobody checks

tuples.episode_object: a metal gate cold under the fingers
tuples.time_place_scope: a park entrance on a cool morning
tuples.mechanism: a sharp temperature contrast noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: metal reports temperature faster than anything else you will touch outdoors

tuples.episode_object: a puddle reflecting the sky
tuples.time_place_scope: a path the day after rain
tuples.mechanism: looking down at something that shows what is above
tuples.evidence_lens: look into it rather than around it; a puddle is a window in the wrong direction

tuples.episode_object: gravel shifting under each step
tuples.time_place_scope: a loose surfaced path in a park
tuples.mechanism: sound and touch arriving together
tuples.evidence_lens: notice that two senses report the same event; they usually agree and are rarely compared

tuples.episode_object: the taste of cold air at the back of the throat
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk on a very cold clear morning
tuples.mechanism: taste noticed where it is not expected
tuples.evidence_lens: breathe through the mouth once; cold air has a taste and it only appears below a certain temperature

tuples.episode_object: moss on a north-facing wall
tuples.time_place_scope: a shaded section of a walking route
tuples.mechanism: noticing something that only grows in one place
tuples.evidence_lens: look at where it is and is not; the pattern tells you which way you are facing

tuples.episode_object: a distant siren rising and falling
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk within earshot of a main road
tuples.mechanism: a sound tracked as it moves away
tuples.evidence_lens: follow it until it is gone; a sound that leaves gives a natural ending

tuples.episode_object: sunlight broken by moving leaves
tuples.time_place_scope: a tree-lined path on a bright breezy day
tuples.mechanism: watching light change rapidly
tuples.evidence_lens: let the eyes follow the flicker; fast change holds attention with no effort at all

tuples.episode_object: a wooden fence's grain under a fingertip
tuples.time_place_scope: a boundary fence along a footpath
tuples.mechanism: a fine texture explored slowly
tuples.evidence_lens: move the finger slowly enough to feel the grain; speed destroys fine touch

tuples.episode_object: the smell of cut grass from a garden
tuples.time_place_scope: a residential walk in mowing season
tuples.mechanism: a seasonal smell recognised in passing
tuples.evidence_lens: name the season from the smell; smells carry dates more reliably than views do

tuples.episode_object: a dog barking two streets away
tuples.time_place_scope: a quiet walk in the early evening
tuples.mechanism: a distant sound left uninvestigated
tuples.evidence_lens: hear it and do not wonder about it; letting a sound be only a sound is the skill

tuples.episode_object: a bench passed without sitting on it
tuples.time_place_scope: a park path with somewhere to stop
tuples.mechanism: a choice noticed rather than made automatically
tuples.evidence_lens: notice that you chose to keep walking; unmade choices are choices too

tuples.episode_object: the last hundred metres back to the door
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of the loop
tuples.mechanism: attention gathered for a final stretch
tuples.evidence_lens: pick one sense for the last stretch; ending with a single sense makes a clean finish

tuples.episode_object: the front gate closed behind you
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment the walk finishes
tuples.mechanism: an ending marked with a small action
tuples.evidence_lens: close it deliberately; the walk had a start and it deserves a stated end

tuples.episode_object: an herb leaf crushed lightly
tuples.time_place_scope: a shaded corner of a small garden
tuples.mechanism: scent attention released by touch
tuples.evidence_lens: crush and then smell; making a scent happen is more absorbing than finding one

tuples.episode_object: a sun-warmed stone bench
tuples.time_place_scope: a quiet garden corner in the afternoon
tuples.mechanism: contact-point and temperature noticing
tuples.evidence_lens: sit and let the stone be warmer than expected; stone holds heat longer than anything else out here

tuples.episode_object: a bee working over one flower
tuples.time_place_scope: a border in full flower on a still day
tuples.mechanism: a small creature watched at close range
tuples.evidence_lens: watch one insect until it moves on; it will set the length of the practice for you

tuples.episode_object: soil under a fingernail
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden after five minutes of small work
tuples.mechanism: noticing a physical trace of an activity
tuples.evidence_lens: look at your own hands; they record what you have been doing without being asked

tuples.episode_object: a seed head gone dry and papery
tuples.time_place_scope: a border at the end of the growing season
tuples.mechanism: a change of texture over a season noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: feel how brittle it has become; the same plant felt entirely different two months ago

tuples.episode_object: a lawnmower running two gardens away
tuples.time_place_scope: a suburban garden on a Saturday afternoon
tuples.mechanism: a distant human sound accepted
tuples.evidence_lens: let someone else's task be part of the background; it is not an intrusion unless you make it one

tuples.episode_object: a spider's thread catching the light
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden in low morning sun
tuples.mechanism: noticing something only visible at one angle
tuples.evidence_lens: move your head until it appears and disappears; the thread is always there and the angle is not

tuples.episode_object: water in a butt with a still surface
tuples.time_place_scope: a corner beside a shed after a dry week
tuples.mechanism: a still surface looked into
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the surface rather than through it; stillness is a quality that can be attended to directly

tuples.episode_object: a weed pulled cleanly with its root
tuples.time_place_scope: a bed being tidied for a few minutes
tuples.mechanism: one small task completed properly
tuples.evidence_lens: get the root; the satisfaction is real and the difference is felt in the hand

tuples.episode_object: the smell of a tomato plant's leaves
tuples.time_place_scope: a greenhouse or a sunny corner in summer
tuples.mechanism: a distinctive scent noticed deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: brush the leaves and breathe in; this smell is unmistakable and it only lasts a few seconds

tuples.episode_object: a bird bath with a bird arriving
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden watched from a step or a chair
tuples.mechanism: waiting for something that may not happen
tuples.evidence_lens: wait without requiring the bird; the waiting is the practice and the bird is optional

tuples.episode_object: a garden chair's damp seat
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden in the early morning with dew still down
tuples.mechanism: a small discomfort noticed at the point of contact
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the damp and decide whether to sit; deciding rather than flinching is the difference

tuples.episode_object: the rim of a terracotta pot
tuples.time_place_scope: a patio with pots along the edge
tuples.mechanism: a rough familiar texture handled
tuples.evidence_lens: run a thumb along the rim; terracotta has a specific feel that plastic does not

tuples.episode_object: a leaf beginning to turn colour
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden in the first weeks of autumn
tuples.mechanism: an early sign of a season noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: find the first one; looking for a first is a search with a clear success condition

tuples.episode_object: a hosepipe coiled and put away
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a watering session
tuples.mechanism: a tool stored properly after use
tuples.evidence_lens: coil it neatly; the neatness is for the next time and the attention is for now

tuples.episode_object: a shed door standing open
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden with the tools out
tuples.mechanism: noticing something left unfinished
tuples.evidence_lens: see it and close it; a small open loop closed immediately does not become a nagging one

tuples.episode_object: a fence post's lichen
tuples.time_place_scope: an old boundary fence in a mature garden
tuples.mechanism: close looking at something extremely slow
tuples.evidence_lens: look at something that has taken years; there is nothing to watch happen and that is the point

tuples.episode_object: grass under bare feet
tuples.time_place_scope: a lawn on a warm evening
tuples.mechanism: direct contact with the ground
tuples.evidence_lens: take the shoes off for one minute; the feet have not touched grass in a long time

tuples.episode_object: dusk arriving in the garden
tuples.time_place_scope: the last light of an evening outdoors
tuples.mechanism: a gradual change of light noticed over minutes
tuples.evidence_lens: stay long enough for the light to change; the change is slow and needs a decision to see it

tuples.episode_object: the back door reached at the end
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of going back indoors
tuples.mechanism: a return chosen rather than drifted into
tuples.evidence_lens: decide to go in and then go; the deliberate ending is what makes a short garden pause a whole one

tuples.episode_object: a rain-streaked pane
tuples.time_place_scope: a quiet room during an afternoon shower
tuples.mechanism: steady sound-pattern attention
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to the rain rather than watching it; the sound is more constant than the picture

tuples.episode_object: a loose window latch rattling
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where the wind is finding a gap
tuples.mechanism: securing a small annoyance deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: fix it and notice the difference; the completed small task is what settles the room

tuples.episode_object: one drop running faster than the others
tuples.time_place_scope: a window during heavy rain
tuples.mechanism: following a single element in a busy field
tuples.evidence_lens: pick one and follow it; losing it and choosing another is the repetition being practised

tuples.episode_object: a gutter overflowing at one corner
tuples.time_place_scope: a house during a downpour
tuples.mechanism: noticing where a system is failing
tuples.evidence_lens: observe it without immediately solving it; today it is a thing to watch, not a job

tuples.episode_object: the light in the room going grey
tuples.time_place_scope: a living room as a storm arrives
tuples.mechanism: a change of indoor light noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the room dimming without the lights changing; the weather is redecorating

tuples.episode_object: a puddle forming on a path outside
tuples.time_place_scope: a window overlooking a garden in rain
tuples.mechanism: watching something accumulate slowly
tuples.evidence_lens: look twice, five minutes apart; accumulation is only visible across two observations

tuples.episode_object: a windowsill cool under the forearms
tuples.time_place_scope: a window leaned on while the rain falls
tuples.mechanism: a resting position taken at a window
tuples.evidence_lens: lean and let the sill take the weight; comfort makes a five-minute watch possible

tuples.episode_object: a drip falling from an eave at intervals
tuples.time_place_scope: a window under an overhanging roof
tuples.mechanism: an irregular repeated sound counted loosely
tuples.evidence_lens: wait for the next one; waiting for a sound is a very simple thing to do well

tuples.episode_object: the smell of rain on warm ground
tuples.time_place_scope: a window opened after the first rain in weeks
tuples.mechanism: a distinctive smell noticed at its arrival
tuples.evidence_lens: open the window when it starts; the smell is strongest in the first few minutes

tuples.episode_object: thunder heard some seconds after lightning
tuples.time_place_scope: a room during a distant storm
tuples.mechanism: a delay measured between two events
tuples.evidence_lens: count the gap; a simple measurement gives attention something definite to do

tuples.episode_object: a car passing through standing water
tuples.time_place_scope: a window above a wet street
tuples.mechanism: a brief loud sound anticipated and heard
tuples.evidence_lens: you can see it coming and then hear it; the pairing of sight and sound is unusually clean

tuples.episode_object: an umbrella dripping by the front door
tuples.time_place_scope: a hallway after someone has come in
tuples.mechanism: a trace of the weather noticed indoors
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the small pool forming; the rain has come inside in a very literal way

tuples.episode_object: rain drumming on a flat roof
tuples.time_place_scope: an extension or conservatory during a shower
tuples.mechanism: a loud continuous sound rested in
tuples.evidence_lens: sit under it and let it be loud; there is no requirement for quiet in any of this

tuples.episode_object: condensation forming on the inside
tuples.time_place_scope: a warm room with cold rain outside
tuples.mechanism: noticing a difference made visible
tuples.evidence_lens: see the temperature difference on the glass; physics rendered as something you can draw in

tuples.episode_object: a window seat with nothing to do in it
tuples.time_place_scope: an afternoon with plans cancelled by weather
tuples.mechanism: an unplanned empty hour used rather than filled
tuples.evidence_lens: sit without a book or a phone for five minutes; the weather has given you the time

tuples.episode_object: the sound changing as the rain eases
tuples.time_place_scope: the last part of a shower
tuples.mechanism: noticing a gradual reduction
tuples.evidence_lens: listen for the change rather than checking whether it has stopped; the ears will tell you first

tuples.episode_object: the moment the rain actually stops
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a long period of rainfall
tuples.mechanism: an ending noticed as it occurs
tuples.evidence_lens: catch the stop; if you were listening you will notice it, and if not you will not

tuples.episode_object: drips continuing after the rain has ended
tuples.time_place_scope: the quarter-hour following a shower
tuples.mechanism: an after-effect attended to
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to what is left over; the aftermath is quieter and lasts longer than the event

tuples.episode_object: light returning through a break in cloud
tuples.time_place_scope: a window as the weather clears
tuples.mechanism: a change of light welcomed without chasing
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the brightening; the room changes colour and it takes about a minute

tuples.episode_object: a window opened onto washed air
tuples.time_place_scope: the first minutes after the rain has passed
tuples.mechanism: outdoor air met at its freshest
tuples.evidence_lens: open it and take one breath; the air after rain is genuinely different and briefly so

tuples.episode_object: a canopy moving above a still trunk
tuples.time_place_scope: beneath a large tree on a breezy afternoon
tuples.mechanism: noticing movement and stillness in one object
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the top, then the base; the same tree is doing two different things at once

tuples.episode_object: the rush of leaves in a gust
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden or park as a gust arrives
tuples.mechanism: a sound followed from its beginning to its end
tuples.evidence_lens: a gust has a clear start and finish; follow one all the way through

tuples.episode_object: the pause between two gusts
tuples.time_place_scope: an exposed spot on a changeable day
tuples.mechanism: waiting in a gap without filling it
tuples.evidence_lens: the gap arrives on its own; the only instruction is to still be there when the next gust comes

tuples.episode_object: a pine's sound compared with a broadleaf's
tuples.time_place_scope: a place where two kinds of tree stand near each other
tuples.mechanism: two similar sounds distinguished
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to each in turn; they are genuinely different and the difference is easy to hear once sought

tuples.episode_object: wind felt on the face before it is heard
tuples.time_place_scope: an open field or hillside
tuples.mechanism: noticing which sense reports first
tuples.evidence_lens: see which arrives first, the feeling or the sound; usually it is not what you expect

tuples.episode_object: a single leaf detaching and falling
tuples.time_place_scope: a tree in early autumn on a windy day
tuples.mechanism: a small event watched to its conclusion
tuples.evidence_lens: follow it to the ground; a complete small event is a complete small practice

tuples.episode_object: a hedge moving in sections
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden boundary on a gusty morning
tuples.mechanism: watching a wave move through something
tuples.evidence_lens: see the wind travel along it; the hedge makes the wind's direction visible

tuples.episode_object: a bare tree's branches in winter wind
tuples.time_place_scope: a leafless tree in a cold month
tuples.mechanism: noticing sound made by shape rather than leaves
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to a tree with nothing on it; the sound is thinner and quite different

tuples.episode_object: a tree's shadow moving across the ground
tuples.time_place_scope: a sunny breezy day with clear shadows
tuples.mechanism: movement watched indirectly
tuples.evidence_lens: watch the shadow instead of the tree; the ground shows the same movement in a flatter way

tuples.episode_object: a rope or swing moving without anyone on it
tuples.time_place_scope: an empty garden or playground in the wind
tuples.mechanism: an object moved by something invisible
tuples.evidence_lens: watch something inanimate being moved; the wind becomes obvious through what it touches

tuples.episode_object: a fence creaking in a strong gust
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden during a windy evening
tuples.mechanism: a strained sound noticed without alarm
tuples.evidence_lens: hear it as a sound rather than as a warning; most creaking is just wood doing its job

tuples.episode_object: seed heads shaking on tall stems
tuples.time_place_scope: a verge or meadow in late summer
tuples.mechanism: a fine rapid movement observed
tuples.evidence_lens: watch the smallest moving things; fine movement is more absorbing than large movement

tuples.episode_object: wind direction guessed from the trees
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk where the wind keeps changing
tuples.mechanism: a small deduction made from observation
tuples.evidence_lens: decide which way it is coming from; a guess that can be checked keeps attention honest

tuples.episode_object: a window rattling in its frame
tuples.time_place_scope: indoors during a windy night
tuples.mechanism: an outdoor force noticed from inside
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to the weather through the building; the house is reporting on the outside

tuples.episode_object: leaves scraping along a pavement
tuples.time_place_scope: a street in autumn during a strong wind
tuples.mechanism: a dry scraping sound followed
tuples.evidence_lens: a very specific seasonal sound; it is available for about six weeks a year

tuples.episode_object: a tree heard but not seen at night
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden after dark on a windy evening
tuples.mechanism: listening in the absence of sight
tuples.evidence_lens: stand outside in the dark and only listen; removing sight makes hearing surprisingly detailed

tuples.episode_object: a gust arriving from behind
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk in changeable weather
tuples.mechanism: a surprise met without reacting
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the startle and let it pass; startles last less than a second if they are not extended

tuples.episode_object: the sound of wind through an open window
tuples.time_place_scope: a room with the window opened on a breezy day
tuples.mechanism: outdoor sound brought indoors deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: open it on purpose and listen; the room becomes a different room for five minutes

tuples.episode_object: branches settling as the wind drops
tuples.time_place_scope: the end of a windy spell
tuples.mechanism: noticing movement come to rest
tuples.evidence_lens: wait for the stillness; watching something stop is easier than watching something be still

tuples.episode_object: the quiet that follows a windy afternoon
tuples.time_place_scope: an evening after the weather has calmed
tuples.mechanism: a contrast noticed after hours of noise
tuples.evidence_lens: notice how quiet it now seems; the quiet is ordinary and only the contrast makes it audible

tuples.episode_object: breath visible for the first time this year
tuples.time_place_scope: a doorstep on the first genuinely cold morning
tuples.mechanism: a seasonal first noticed as it happens
tuples.evidence_lens: notice that this is the first time; firsts are only firsts if someone marks them

tuples.episode_object: a coat taken out of a cupboard
tuples.time_place_scope: a hallway where the weather has changed overnight
tuples.mechanism: a stored object handled after months
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the smell and the weight; it has been in a cupboard since spring

tuples.episode_object: a cold floor underfoot
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom before the heating has come on
tuples.mechanism: temperature met through the soles
tuples.evidence_lens: stand still on it for three seconds; the floor was this temperature last week too, unnoticed

tuples.episode_object: dew heavy on a lawn
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden in the early morning of a cold day
tuples.mechanism: a change of surface noticed outdoors
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the grass rather than the sky; the ground reports the season more accurately

tuples.episode_object: a windscreen misted on the inside
tuples.time_place_scope: a car on a cold morning before setting off
tuples.mechanism: waiting for something to clear rather than rushing it
tuples.evidence_lens: the wait is unavoidable; use it as the pause it already is

tuples.episode_object: the boiler starting for the first time in months
tuples.time_place_scope: a house on the morning the heating comes back on
tuples.mechanism: a familiar sound heard again after an absence
tuples.evidence_lens: notice that you recognise it; the sound has been gone since March

tuples.episode_object: a scarf found in a drawer
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom on a morning that needs more layers
tuples.mechanism: a seasonal object returned to use
tuples.evidence_lens: handle it once before putting it on; objects that come back are worth a moment

tuples.episode_object: hands cold before the walk has really started
tuples.time_place_scope: the first minutes outdoors on a cold morning
tuples.mechanism: a change noticed faster than expected
tuples.evidence_lens: notice how quickly the hands report; extremities are the first to say what the weather is

tuples.episode_object: the light arriving later than it did
tuples.time_place_scope: a morning in the weeks after the equinox
tuples.mechanism: noticing a change in daylight timing
tuples.evidence_lens: observe that it is darker at the same hour; the change is gradual and only visible in comparison

tuples.episode_object: a doorknob cold enough to be startling
tuples.time_place_scope: an unheated hallway first thing
tuples.mechanism: a sharp temperature contact
tuples.evidence_lens: metal reports cold instantly; it is the fastest thermometer in the house

tuples.episode_object: berries visible in a hedge
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk on a cold clear autumn morning
tuples.mechanism: a seasonal change noticed in a plant
tuples.evidence_lens: look for what is there now that was not in July; the hedge changes and nobody watches

tuples.episode_object: a jumper pulled on for the first time since spring
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom on a morning that has turned
tuples.mechanism: a texture met again after a long gap
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the wool against the arms; it will be unremarkable again within a week

tuples.episode_object: a hot drink wanted rather than habitual
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen on the first cold morning
tuples.mechanism: noticing a want as it arises
tuples.evidence_lens: see that the weather created the wish; wants have causes and they are usually visible

tuples.episode_object: a window left open overnight and now closed
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom that has grown colder than intended
tuples.mechanism: a small correction made to a room
tuples.evidence_lens: close it and notice the room begin to change; the effect takes about ten minutes

tuples.episode_object: a first frost on a car roof
tuples.time_place_scope: a street early on a clear cold morning
tuples.mechanism: a fine surface pattern looked at closely
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the crystals before scraping them; they will be gone in thirty seconds

tuples.episode_object: a bed that feels harder to leave
tuples.time_place_scope: the moments after waking on a cold morning
tuples.mechanism: noticing reluctance as a bodily state
tuples.evidence_lens: observe the reluctance rather than arguing with it; it is a temperature response as much as anything

tuples.episode_object: the sound of a house's heating expanding
tuples.time_place_scope: a room in the half hour after the heating starts
tuples.mechanism: small unfamiliar sounds identified
tuples.evidence_lens: work out what the ticking is; identifying a sound removes it as a background irritation

tuples.episode_object: socks put on before getting out of bed
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom on a morning below the usual temperature
tuples.mechanism: a practical adaptation made deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: adapt rather than endure; adapting on purpose is a small act of attention to yourself

tuples.episode_object: a plan for the day quietly changed by weather
tuples.time_place_scope: a morning where the cold alters what will happen
tuples.mechanism: noticing an adjustment being made
tuples.evidence_lens: catch the decision as it is made; most weather decisions are made without ever being noticed

tuples.episode_object: the front door opened onto genuinely cold air
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of stepping out for the first time
tuples.mechanism: a strong sensation met at a threshold
tuples.evidence_lens: take one breath on the step; the first breath of a cold morning is the sharpest one

tuples.episode_object: snow lying evenly on a garden wall
tuples.time_place_scope: a residential street after an overnight fall
tuples.mechanism: an even surface looked at closely
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the line along the top; snow makes ordinary shapes visible by outlining them

tuples.episode_object: the unusual quietness of a snowy street
tuples.time_place_scope: a road with little traffic after heavy snow
tuples.mechanism: noticing sound absorbed rather than absent
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to how muffled everything is; snow changes the acoustics of a whole street

tuples.episode_object: the first footprints on an untouched pavement
tuples.time_place_scope: an early morning before anyone else is out
tuples.mechanism: a mark made deliberately on a blank surface
tuples.evidence_lens: look back at your own prints; you have changed something and can see exactly how

tuples.episode_object: flakes visible only in a streetlight's cone
tuples.time_place_scope: a street at night while snow is falling
tuples.mechanism: something made visible by a single light source
tuples.evidence_lens: stand under the light and look up; the snow was falling everywhere and only shows here

tuples.episode_object: snow compressing underfoot with a squeak
tuples.time_place_scope: a very cold day with dry snow
tuples.mechanism: a distinctive sound produced by your own weight
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to the squeak; it only happens below a certain temperature and it is unmistakable

tuples.episode_object: cold landing on the face while walking
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk while snow is actively falling
tuples.mechanism: individual points of contact noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: feel single flakes rather than general cold; it is a surprisingly precise sensation

tuples.episode_object: a branch bent under accumulated weight
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden tree after a heavy fall
tuples.mechanism: noticing load carried by something living
tuples.evidence_lens: look at how much it has bent; the snow's weight is invisible except through what holds it

tuples.episode_object: a car roof with an untouched layer
tuples.time_place_scope: a parked street the morning after snow
tuples.mechanism: noticing an undisturbed surface
tuples.evidence_lens: find one that nobody has touched; undisturbed surfaces are rare and short-lived

tuples.episode_object: the particular flat light of a snowy day
tuples.time_place_scope: a room looking out onto snow-covered ground
tuples.mechanism: a change of indoor light noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the light coming up from below; snow lights rooms from the wrong direction

tuples.episode_object: snow melting on a coat sleeve
tuples.time_place_scope: a doorway after coming in from outside
tuples.mechanism: a change of state watched at close range
tuples.evidence_lens: watch one flake go; the whole event takes about four seconds

tuples.episode_object: tyre tracks cutting two dark lines
tuples.time_place_scope: a road that has had a few cars on it
tuples.mechanism: noticing a pattern made by traffic
tuples.evidence_lens: look at what the road records; snow turns a street into a diagram of the morning

tuples.episode_object: a bird's tracks across a lawn
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden the morning after a light fall
tuples.mechanism: reading a record left by something you did not see
tuples.evidence_lens: follow the tracks with your eyes; something happened here and left a legible account

tuples.episode_object: a gate that will not open against the drift
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden path after a windy snowfall
tuples.mechanism: a small obstruction met patiently
tuples.evidence_lens: clear it rather than forcing it; a minute of clearing beats a broken gate

tuples.episode_object: a shovel scraping on a path
tuples.time_place_scope: a driveway being cleared in the morning
tuples.mechanism: a repetitive physical task with an obvious result
tuples.evidence_lens: work in strips and watch the cleared area grow; visible progress carries the effort

tuples.episode_object: a child's excitement at the window
tuples.time_place_scope: a house where someone else has just seen the snow
tuples.mechanism: another person's reaction noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: watch the reaction rather than the snow for ten seconds; it is the better view

tuples.episode_object: the temperature felt on the ears
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk without a hat on a cold day
tuples.mechanism: a specific exposed area noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: the ears report first; find the coldest part of yourself and name it

tuples.episode_object: snow beginning to grey at the kerbside
tuples.time_place_scope: a street a day or two after the fall
tuples.mechanism: noticing decline in something that was pristine
tuples.evidence_lens: look at it plainly; the dirty stage is as real as the clean one and lasts much longer

tuples.episode_object: water running at the edge of a thaw
tuples.time_place_scope: a street on the first warmer day
tuples.mechanism: a change of season within a week noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: listen to the running water; the thaw is audible before it is fully visible

tuples.episode_object: a window looked out of rather than a screen
tuples.time_place_scope: an indoor day when going out is difficult
tuples.mechanism: a long look outside taken deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: give the window five minutes; snow is one of the few things worth watching do nothing

tuples.episode_object: the last patch of snow in a shaded corner
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden several days after the rest has gone
tuples.mechanism: noticing a remnant that has outlasted the event
tuples.evidence_lens: find the last of it; the corner that keeps snow longest tells you where the sun never reaches

tuples.episode_object: the edge between sunlight and shade
tuples.time_place_scope: a courtyard at the hottest part of the day
tuples.mechanism: a boundary crossed and recrossed
tuples.evidence_lens: step over the line twice; the difference is immediate and larger than expected

tuples.episode_object: a wall's cool surface on the shaded side
tuples.time_place_scope: a narrow street with one side in shadow
tuples.mechanism: stored coolness found in a solid object
tuples.evidence_lens: put a palm on it; thick walls stay cool for hours and almost nobody tests this

tuples.episode_object: still air under a tree
tuples.time_place_scope: a park at midday in high summer
tuples.mechanism: noticing the absence of movement in air
tuples.evidence_lens: notice how still it is; stillness in air is a real quality and it is felt on the skin

tuples.episode_object: a cold glass sweating in the hand
tuples.time_place_scope: a shaded table on a hot afternoon
tuples.mechanism: condensation felt as well as seen
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the wet on the fingers; the glass is producing water out of the air

tuples.episode_object: insects sounding continuously in the heat
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden or field in the middle of a hot day
tuples.mechanism: a constant natural sound rested on
tuples.evidence_lens: let it be one continuous sound rather than many; it does not stop and it does not need managing

tuples.episode_object: shade moving as the sun crosses
tuples.time_place_scope: a fixed seat over the course of an hour
tuples.mechanism: a slow change tracked by staying put
tuples.evidence_lens: mark where the shade ends and check again later; the earth moves and this proves it

tuples.episode_object: a stone floor cool through thin soles
tuples.time_place_scope: an indoor room with shutters closed at noon
tuples.mechanism: coolness met at the feet
tuples.evidence_lens: stand on the stone; floors are the coolest part of a hot house and are rarely used for it

tuples.episode_object: sweat cooling as a breeze arrives
tuples.time_place_scope: a shaded spot when the air finally moves
tuples.mechanism: an evaporative change noticed on the skin
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the cooling rather than the breeze; the skin is doing the work

tuples.episode_object: a hat brim's shadow on the face
tuples.time_place_scope: an outdoor space with strong overhead sun
tuples.mechanism: a small personal shade noticed
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the line across the face; you are carrying a piece of shade with you

tuples.episode_object: water run over the inside of the wrists
tuples.time_place_scope: a tap or fountain during a hot afternoon
tuples.mechanism: cooling applied at a specific point
tuples.evidence_lens: wrists rather than face; the effect is disproportionate and quick

tuples.episode_object: a dog lying flat in the coolest spot
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden or doorway in the heat of the day
tuples.mechanism: learning something from another creature's choice
tuples.evidence_lens: notice where they chose; animals find the coolest place first and are worth copying

tuples.episode_object: an awning's shade over a doorway
tuples.time_place_scope: a street with somewhere to stand out of the sun
tuples.mechanism: shelter used deliberately rather than passed through
tuples.evidence_lens: stop under it for a minute; the shelter is there and it costs nothing to use

tuples.episode_object: the heat felt radiating from a pavement
tuples.time_place_scope: a street where the ground has been in sun all day
tuples.mechanism: heat noticed coming from below
tuples.evidence_lens: feel the warmth on the shins; the ground gives back what it took all morning

tuples.episode_object: a fan turning at a low setting
tuples.time_place_scope: an indoor room during a heatwave
tuples.mechanism: a repeated movement of air felt in cycles
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the rhythm of the air arriving; the fan makes the air countable

tuples.episode_object: a shuttered room dim at midday
tuples.time_place_scope: a house closed up against the heat
tuples.mechanism: darkness used in the middle of the day
tuples.evidence_lens: sit in the dim room; it is midday and it looks like evening, which is worth noticing

tuples.episode_object: a slower pace chosen on purpose
tuples.time_place_scope: a walk that has to happen despite the heat
tuples.mechanism: speed reduced as an adaptation
tuples.evidence_lens: walk slower deliberately; the heat is a good reason and the practice is the deciding

tuples.episode_object: a shaded bench with a view of the sun
tuples.time_place_scope: a park where the shade and the light meet
tuples.mechanism: looking at brightness from within shade
tuples.evidence_lens: look out at the bright ground from the cool; the contrast is the whole pleasure

tuples.episode_object: a quiet hour when nobody is outside
tuples.time_place_scope: a neighbourhood at the hottest part of the afternoon
tuples.mechanism: noticing an absence of people
tuples.evidence_lens: notice how empty it is; heat empties a street as reliably as rain does

tuples.episode_object: a cold drink finished slowly
tuples.time_place_scope: a shaded seat with time to sit
tuples.mechanism: consumption paced deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: make it last; finishing quickly wastes both the drink and the sitting

tuples.episode_object: stepping back out into the sun
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment of leaving the shade
tuples.mechanism: a return to heat noticed at the first second
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the heat land on the shoulders; the first second is the clearest one

tuples.episode_object: a shaded bedside lamp switched on
tuples.time_place_scope: the hour before bed with the main lights still on
tuples.mechanism: single-task closing ritual
tuples.evidence_lens: turn on the small light before turning off the big one; the order is the whole ritual

tuples.episode_object: a dimmer switch turned down by degrees
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedside in the last minutes of the evening
tuples.mechanism: gradual light lowering
tuples.evidence_lens: lower it in three stages; three stages take fifteen seconds and feel entirely different from one

tuples.episode_object: a book closed with a finger marking nothing
tuples.time_place_scope: a bed where the reading is finished for the night
tuples.mechanism: an ending accepted rather than extended
tuples.evidence_lens: stop at the end of a chapter and close it; one more page is the habit being worked with

tuples.episode_object: a phone put on charge across the room
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom being prepared for sleep
tuples.mechanism: a device placed out of reach
tuples.evidence_lens: the distance does the work; a decision made about location is more durable than one about willpower

tuples.episode_object: a bedside clock turned to face away
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom on a night when sleep may be difficult
tuples.mechanism: a source of pressure removed from view
tuples.evidence_lens: turn it away before getting in; removing the option is easier than resisting it at three in the morning

tuples.episode_object: curtains drawn fully across
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom with a streetlight outside
tuples.mechanism: one preparation completed thoroughly
tuples.evidence_lens: close the gap in the middle; the gap is the part that matters and it takes two seconds

tuples.episode_object: a glass of water set within reach
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedside table being arranged for the night
tuples.mechanism: a future need anticipated
tuples.evidence_lens: put it where you can find it in the dark; care for a later version of yourself

tuples.episode_object: an alarm set and then not checked again
tuples.time_place_scope: the last minutes before lying down
tuples.mechanism: one check made and trusted
tuples.evidence_lens: set it once and believe it; the second check is where the night starts going wrong

tuples.episode_object: a pillow arranged the way you like it
tuples.time_place_scope: a bed being got into
tuples.mechanism: a small adjustment made before settling
tuples.evidence_lens: arrange it now rather than after lying down; thirty seconds now saves ten minutes of fidgeting

tuples.episode_object: the duvet's weight settling over the body
tuples.time_place_scope: the first moments after lying down
tuples.mechanism: weight noticed as it arrives
tuples.evidence_lens: notice the weight across the chest and legs; it is substantial and almost never attended to

tuples.episode_object: the room's temperature judged from under the covers
tuples.time_place_scope: a bed on a night that may be too warm or too cold
tuples.mechanism: a practical assessment made from inside
tuples.evidence_lens: decide within the first minute; adjusting now is easier than waking at two to do it

tuples.episode_object: a landing light left on for someone else
tuples.time_place_scope: a household where not everyone is asleep
tuples.mechanism: a small consideration for another person
tuples.evidence_lens: leave it deliberately rather than forgetting to turn it off; the same result, a different act

tuples.episode_object: a bedroom door pulled to but not latched
tuples.time_place_scope: the final arrangement of the room
tuples.mechanism: a boundary set to a chosen degree
tuples.evidence_lens: choose how much open; small preferences deserve to be chosen rather than defaulted

tuples.episode_object: a lamp's warmth near the hand
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedside with the light on for a while
tuples.mechanism: heat noticed from a small source
tuples.evidence_lens: hold a hand near the shade; a bulb makes real warmth and it is a surprise every time

tuples.episode_object: the click of the lamp switch
tuples.time_place_scope: the moment the last light goes out
tuples.mechanism: a definite final action
tuples.evidence_lens: hear the click; it is the last sound you will make deliberately today

tuples.episode_object: the dark immediately after the light goes
tuples.time_place_scope: the first seconds of a dark bedroom
tuples.mechanism: eyes adjusting noticed as it happens
tuples.evidence_lens: keep the eyes open for ten seconds; the room slowly reappears and it is worth watching once

tuples.episode_object: the sounds a house makes when it is quiet
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom in the minutes after the light is off
tuples.mechanism: listening in the dark without investigating
tuples.evidence_lens: hear the sounds and do not identify them; identification is the thing that keeps people awake

tuples.episode_object: a last look around the room before the light goes
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom with everything now arranged
tuples.mechanism: a closing survey taken deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: look once and then switch off; the look confirms that nothing is left and permits the switch

tuples.episode_object: a candle blown out at a bedside
tuples.time_place_scope: a room where a small flame has been burning
tuples.mechanism: a flame extinguished attentively
tuples.evidence_lens: watch the smoke for two seconds; endings that leave a trace are easy to notice

tuples.episode_object: the body arranged in a chosen position
tuples.time_place_scope: the last conscious act before sleep
tuples.mechanism: settling once rather than repeatedly
tuples.evidence_lens: settle deliberately and then stay; the practice ends here and sleep is not part of the instruction
